```{r check prior year bets 2024}
df_totals_profit_2024 =
  df_open_lines_2024 %>% 
  left_join(df_pred_total_spread_adj_2024, by = c("team_home", "team_away")) %>% 
  left_join(df_game_sims_2024, by = "game_id") %>% 
  left_join(szn_all %>% distinct(game_id, total_line, spread_line) %>% rename(total_line_current = total_line), by = "game_id") %>% 
  mutate(
    over_odds = -112, 
    under_odds = -112,
    over_odds_current = -112, 
    under_odds_current = -112,
    p_over = map_dbl(total_sim_adj, ~ mean(.x > total_line, na.rm = T)),
    p_under = 1 - p_over,
    p_over_current  = map_dbl(total_sim_adj, ~ mean(.x > total_line_current, na.rm = T)),
    p_under_current = 1 - p_over_current,
    odds_over_current_dec =
      if_else(
        over_odds_current < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(over_odds_current),
        1 + over_odds_current / 100
      ),
    odds_under_current_dec =
      if_else(
        under_odds_current < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(under_odds_current),
        1 + under_odds_current / 100
      ),
    odds_over_dec =
      if_else(
        over_odds < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(over_odds),
        1 + over_odds / 100
      ),
    odds_under_dec =
      if_else(
        under_odds < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(under_odds),
        1 + under_odds / 100
      ),
    ev_over_current  = p_over_current  * (odds_over_current_dec  - 1) - (1 - p_over_current),
    ev_under_current = p_under_current * (odds_under_current_dec - 1) - (1 - p_under_current),
    ev_over  = p_over  * (odds_over_dec - 1) - (1 - p_over),
    ev_under = p_under * (odds_under_dec - 1) - (1 - p_under),
    bet_total =
      case_when(
        ev_over  > 0.03 ~ "Bet Over",
        ev_under > 0.03 ~ "Bet Under",
        .default = "No Bet"
      ),
    bet_current_total =
      case_when(
        ev_over_current  > 0.03 ~ "Bet Over",
        ev_under_current > 0.03 ~ "Bet Under",
        .default = "No Bet"
      ),
    ev_max_total = pmax(ev_over, ev_under),
    ev_max_current_total = pmax(ev_over_current, ev_under_current),
    side_total = case_when(
      p_over  * odds_over_dec  > p_under * odds_under_dec  ~ "Over",
      p_under * odds_under_dec > p_over  * odds_over_dec  ~ "Under",
      .default = NA
    ),
    side_current_total = case_when(
      p_over_current  * odds_over_current_dec  > p_under_current * odds_under_current_dec  ~ "Over",
      p_under_current * odds_under_current_dec > p_over_current  * odds_over_current_dec  ~ "Under",
      .default = NA
    ),
    p_total = if_else(side_total == "Over",  p_over,  p_under),
    p_current_total = if_else(side_current_total == "Over",  p_over_current,  p_under_current),
    dec_odds_total = if_else(side_total == "Over", odds_over_dec, odds_under_dec),
    dec_odds_current_total = if_else(side_current_total == "Over", odds_over_current_dec, odds_under_current_dec),
    kelly_total = (p_total * dec_odds_total - 1) / (dec_odds_total - 1),
    kelly_current_total = (p_current_total * dec_odds_current_total - 1) / (dec_odds_current_total - 1),
    stake_frac_total = pmin(0.03, 0.05 * pmax(kelly_total, 0)),
    stake_total = stake_frac_total * 100,
    stake_frac_current_total = pmin(0.03, 0.05 * pmax(kelly_current_total, 0)),
    stake_current_total = stake_frac_current_total * 100
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # left_join(df_qb_cont_old %>% select(game_id, week, qb_cont), by = c("game_id", "week")) %>% 
  # group_by(game_id) %>%
  # filter(sum(qb_cont) == 2) %>%
  # ungroup() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # filter(stake_total >= 0.5) %>%
  # filter(stake_current_total >= 0.5) %>%
  # filter(ind_total_hit != "No Bet") %>% 
  mutate(
    ind_bet_hit =
      case_when(
        side_total == "Under" & actual_total < total_line ~ 1,
        side_total == "Over" & actual_total > total_line ~ 1,
        side_total == "Under" & actual_total == total_line ~ NA,
        side_total == "Over" & actual_total == total_line ~ NA,
        .default = 0
      ),
    ind_bet_hit_current =
      case_when(
        side_current_total == "Under" & actual_total < total_line_current ~ 1,
        side_current_total == "Over" & actual_total > total_line_current ~ 1,
        side_current_total == "Under" & actual_total == total_line_current ~ NA,
        side_current_total == "Over" & actual_total == total_line_current ~ NA,
        .default = 0
      ),
    profit =
      case_when(
        ind_bet_hit == 1 ~ stake_total * (dec_odds_total - 1),
        ind_bet_hit == 0 ~ -stake_total
      ),
    profit_current =
      case_when(
        ind_bet_hit_current == 1 ~ stake_current_total * (dec_odds_current_total - 1),
        ind_bet_hit_current == 0 ~ -stake_current_total
      )
  ) 
  
df_spreads_profit_2024 =
  df_open_lines_2024 %>% 
  left_join(df_pred_total_spread_adj_2024, by = c("team_home", "team_away")) %>% 
  left_join(df_game_sims_2024, by = "game_id") %>% 
  left_join(szn_all %>% distinct(game_id, total_line, spread_line) %>% rename(spread_line_current = spread_line), by = "game_id") %>% 
  mutate(
    home_odds = -112, 
    away_odds = -112,
    home_odds_current = -112, 
    away_odds_current = -112,
    p_home = map_dbl(spread_sim_adj, ~ mean(.x > spread_line, na.rm = T)),
    p_away = 1 - p_home,
    p_home_current = map_dbl(spread_sim_adj, ~ mean(.x > spread_line_current, na.rm = T)),
    p_away_current = 1 - p_home_current,
    odds_home_dec =
      if_else(
        home_odds < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(home_odds),
        1 + home_odds / 100
      ),
    odds_away_dec =
      if_else(
        away_odds < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(away_odds),
        1 + away_odds / 100
      ),
    odds_home_current_dec =
      if_else(
        home_odds_current < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(home_odds_current),
        1 + home_odds_current / 100
      ),
    odds_away_current_dec =
      if_else(
        away_odds_current < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(away_odds_current),
        1 + away_odds_current / 100
      ),
    ev_home  = p_home  * (odds_home_dec  - 1) - (1 - p_home),
    ev_away = p_away * (odds_away_dec - 1) - (1 - p_away),
    ev_home_current  = p_home_current  * (odds_home_current_dec  - 1) - (1 - p_home_current),
    ev_away_current = p_away_current * (odds_away_current_dec - 1) - (1 - p_away_current),
    bet_spread =
      case_when(
        ev_home > 0.03 ~ "Bet Home",
        ev_away > 0.03 ~ "Bet Away",
        .default = "No Bet"
      ),
    bet_spread_current =
      case_when(
        ev_home_current  > 0.03 ~ "Bet Home",
        ev_away_current > 0.03 ~ "Bet Away",
        .default = "No Bet"
      ),
    ev_max_spread = pmax(ev_home, ev_away),
    ev_max_current_spread = pmax(ev_home_current, ev_away_current),
    side_spread = case_when(
      p_home  * odds_home_dec  > p_away * odds_away_dec  ~ "Home",
      p_away * odds_away_dec > p_home  * odds_home_dec  ~ "Away",
      .default = NA
    ),
    side_current_spread = case_when(
      p_home_current  * odds_home_current_dec  > p_away_current * odds_away_current_dec  ~ "Home",
      p_away_current * odds_away_current_dec > p_home_current  * odds_home_current_dec  ~ "Away",
      .default = NA
    ),
    p_spread = if_else(side_spread == "Home",  p_home,  p_away),
    p_current_spread = if_else(side_current_spread == "Home",  p_home_current,  p_away_current),
    dec_odds_spread = if_else(side_spread == "Home", odds_home_dec, odds_away_dec),
    dec_odds_current_spread = if_else(side_current_spread == "Home", odds_home_current_dec, odds_away_current_dec),
    kelly_spread = (p_spread * dec_odds_spread - 1) / (dec_odds_spread - 1),
    kelly_current_spread = (p_current_spread * dec_odds_current_spread - 1) / (dec_odds_current_spread - 1),
    stake_frac_spread = pmin(0.03, 0.05 * pmax(kelly_spread, 0)),
    stake_frac_current_spread = pmin(0.03, 0.05 * pmax(kelly_current_spread, 0)),
    stake_spread = stake_frac_spread * 100,
    stake_current_spread = stake_frac_current_spread * 100
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # left_join(df_qb_cont_old %>% select(game_id, week, qb_cont), by = c("game_id", "week")) %>% 
  # group_by(game_id) %>%
  # filter(sum(qb_cont) == 2) %>%
  # ungroup() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # filter(stake_spread >= 0.5) %>%
  # filter(stake_current_spread >= 0.5) %>%
  mutate(
    ind_bet_hit =
      case_when(
        side_spread == "Away" & actual_spread < spread_line ~ 1,
        side_spread == "Home" & actual_spread > spread_line ~ 1,
        side_spread == "Away" & actual_spread == spread_line ~ NA,
        side_spread == "Home" & actual_spread == spread_line ~ NA,
        .default = 0
      ),
    ind_bet_hit_current =
      case_when(
        side_current_spread == "Away" & actual_spread < spread_line_current ~ 1,
        side_current_spread == "Home" & actual_spread > spread_line_current ~ 1,
        side_current_spread == "Away" & actual_spread == spread_line_current ~ NA,
        side_current_spread == "Home" & actual_spread == spread_line_current ~ NA,
        .default = 0
      ),
    profit =
      case_when(
        ind_bet_hit == 1 ~ stake_spread * (dec_odds_spread - 1),
        ind_bet_hit == 0 ~ -stake_spread
      ),
    profit_current =
      case_when(
        ind_bet_hit_current == 1 ~ stake_current_spread * (dec_odds_current_spread - 1),
        ind_bet_hit_current == 0 ~ -stake_current_spread
      )
  )

df_totals_profit_2024 %>%
  filter(stake_total >= 0.5) %>%
  mutate(week = str_extract(str_remove(game_id, "^\\d+_"), "\\d+")) %>% 
  # filter(week != 18) %>% 
  group_by(week) %>% 
  summarise(
    profit_tot = sum(profit)
  ) %>% 
  # rows_insert(
  #   tibble(
  #     week = "04",
  #     profit_tot = 0
  #   ),
  #   by = "week"
  # ) %>% 
  arrange(week) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_spreads_profit %>%
      filter(stake_spread >= 0.5) %>%
      mutate(week = str_extract(str_remove(game_id, "^\\d+_"), "\\d+")) %>% 
      # filter(week != 18) %>%
      group_by(week) %>%
      summarise(
        profit_spread = sum(profit)
      ),
    by = "week"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0)),
    week = as.character(week),
    profit_ovr = profit_tot + profit_spread
  ) %>% 
  rows_insert(
    tibble(
      week = "Season",
      profit_tot = sum(.$profit_tot, na.rm = T),
      profit_spread = sum(.$profit_spread, na.rm = T),
      profit_ovr = sum(.$profit_ovr, na.rm = T)
    ),
    by = "week"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(across(starts_with("profit_"), ~ round(., 1))) %>% 
  select(week, profit_tot, profit_spread, profit_ovr) %>% 
  labelled::set_variable_labels(
    week = "Week",
    profit_tot = "Totals",
    profit_spread = "Spreads",
    profit_ovr = "Overall"
  ) %>% 
  gtreg::tbl_listing() %>% 
  gtsummary::modify_caption("**2024 Opening Line Betting Profit by Week (Units)**")

df_totals_profit_2024 %>%
  filter(stake_current_total >= 0.5) %>% 
  mutate(week = str_extract(str_remove(game_id, "^\\d+_"), "\\d+")) %>% 
  # filter(week != 18) %>% 
  group_by(week) %>% 
  summarise(
    profit_tot = sum(profit_current)
  ) %>% 
  # rows_insert(
  #   tibble(
  #     week = "04",
  #     profit_tot = 0
  #   ),
  #   by = "week"
  # ) %>%
  arrange(week) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_spreads_profit_2024 %>%
      filter(stake_current_spread >= 0.5) %>% 
      mutate(week = str_extract(str_remove(game_id, "^\\d+_"), "\\d+")) %>% 
      # filter(week != 18) %>%
      group_by(week) %>%
      summarise(
        profit_spread = sum(profit_current)
      ),
    by = "week"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0)),
    week = as.character(week),
    profit_ovr = profit_tot + profit_spread
  ) %>% 
  rows_insert(
    tibble(
      week = "Season",
      profit_tot = sum(.$profit_tot, na.rm = T),
      profit_spread = sum(.$profit_spread, na.rm = T),
      profit_ovr = sum(.$profit_ovr, na.rm = T)
    ),
    by = "week"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(across(starts_with("profit_"), ~ round(., 1))) %>% 
  select(week, profit_tot, profit_spread, profit_ovr) %>% 
  labelled::set_variable_labels(
    week = "Week",
    profit_tot = "Totals",
    profit_spread = "Spreads",
    profit_ovr = "Overall"
  ) %>% 
  gtreg::tbl_listing() %>% 
  gtsummary::modify_caption("**2024 Closing Line Betting Profit by Week (Units)**")
```

```{r check prior year bets 2025}
df_pred_total_spread_adj_2025 =

    team_away = str_extract(game_id, "[A-Z]+$")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(division_df %>% select(team, division) %>% rename(team_home = team), by = "team_home") %>% 
  left_join(division_df %>% select(team, division) %>% rename(team_away = team, division_opp = division), by = "team_away") %>% 
  group_by(game_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    division_game = ifelse(division == division_opp, 1, 0),
    total_game = sum(mu, na.rm = T),
    actual_total = sum(total_team, na.rm = T),
    spread_game = mu - lead(mu),
    actual_spread = total_team - lead(total_team)

df_totals_profit_2025 =
  df_open_lines_2025 %>% 
  # left_join(df_pred_total_spread_adj, by = c("team_home", "team_away")) %>% 
  left_join(df_pred_total_spread_adj_2025, by = c("game_id")) %>% 
  left_join(df_game_sims_2025, by = "game_id") %>% 
  left_join(szn_all %>% distinct(game_id, total_line, spread_line) %>% rename(total_line_current = total_line), by = "game_id") %>% 
  mutate(
    over_odds = -112, 
    under_odds = -112,
    over_odds_current = -112, 
    under_odds_current = -112,
    p_over = map_dbl(total_sim_adj, ~ mean(.x > total_line, na.rm = T)),
    p_under = 1 - p_over,
    p_over_current  = map_dbl(total_sim_adj, ~ mean(.x > total_line_current, na.rm = T)),
    p_under_current = 1 - p_over_current,
    odds_over_current_dec =
      if_else(
        over_odds_current < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(over_odds_current),
        1 + over_odds_current / 100
      ),
    odds_under_current_dec =
      if_else(
        under_odds_current < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(under_odds_current),
        1 + under_odds_current / 100
      ),
    odds_over_dec =
      if_else(
        over_odds < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(over_odds),
        1 + over_odds / 100
      ),
    odds_under_dec =
      if_else(
        under_odds < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(under_odds),
        1 + under_odds / 100
      ),
    ev_over_current  = p_over_current  * (odds_over_current_dec  - 1) - (1 - p_over_current),
    ev_under_current = p_under_current * (odds_under_current_dec - 1) - (1 - p_under_current),
    ev_over  = p_over  * (odds_over_dec - 1) - (1 - p_over),
    ev_under = p_under * (odds_under_dec - 1) - (1 - p_under),
    bet_total =
      case_when(
        ev_over  > 0.03 ~ "Bet Over",
        ev_under > 0.03 ~ "Bet Under",
        .default = "No Bet"
      ),
    bet_current_total =
      case_when(
        ev_over_current  > 0.03 ~ "Bet Over",
        ev_under_current > 0.03 ~ "Bet Under",
        .default = "No Bet"
      ),
    ev_max_total = pmax(ev_over, ev_under),
    ev_max_current_total = pmax(ev_over_current, ev_under_current),
    side_total = case_when(
      p_over  * odds_over_dec  > p_under * odds_under_dec  ~ "Over",
      p_under * odds_under_dec > p_over  * odds_over_dec  ~ "Under",
      .default = NA
    ),
    side_current_total = case_when(
      p_over_current  * odds_over_current_dec  > p_under_current * odds_under_current_dec  ~ "Over",
      p_under_current * odds_under_current_dec > p_over_current  * odds_over_current_dec  ~ "Under",
      .default = NA
    ),
    p_total = if_else(side_total == "Over",  p_over,  p_under),
    p_current_total = if_else(side_current_total == "Over",  p_over_current,  p_under_current),
    dec_odds_total = if_else(side_total == "Over", odds_over_dec, odds_under_dec),
    dec_odds_current_total = if_else(side_current_total == "Over", odds_over_current_dec, odds_under_current_dec),
    kelly_total = (p_total * dec_odds_total - 1) / (dec_odds_total - 1),
    kelly_current_total = (p_current_total * dec_odds_current_total - 1) / (dec_odds_current_total - 1),
    stake_frac_total = pmin(0.03, 0.05 * pmax(kelly_total, 0)),
    stake_total = stake_frac_total * 100,
    stake_frac_current_total = pmin(0.03, 0.05 * pmax(kelly_current_total, 0)),
    stake_current_total = stake_frac_current_total * 100
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # left_join(df_qb_cont_old %>% select(game_id, week, qb_cont), by = c("game_id", "week")) %>% 
  # group_by(game_id) %>%
  # filter(sum(qb_cont) == 2) %>%
  # ungroup() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # filter(stake_total >= 0.5) %>%
  # filter(stake_current_total >= 0.5) %>%
  # filter(ind_total_hit != "No Bet") %>% 
  mutate(
    ind_bet_hit =
      case_when(
        side_total == "Under" & actual_total < total_line ~ 1,
        side_total == "Over" & actual_total > total_line ~ 1,
        side_total == "Under" & actual_total == total_line ~ NA,
        side_total == "Over" & actual_total == total_line ~ NA,
        .default = 0
      ),
    ind_bet_hit_current =
      case_when(
        side_current_total == "Under" & actual_total < total_line_current ~ 1,
        side_current_total == "Over" & actual_total > total_line_current ~ 1,
        side_current_total == "Under" & actual_total == total_line_current ~ NA,
        side_current_total == "Over" & actual_total == total_line_current ~ NA,
        .default = 0
      ),
    profit =
      case_when(
        ind_bet_hit == 1 ~ stake_total * (dec_odds_total - 1),
        ind_bet_hit == 0 ~ -stake_total
      ),
    profit_current =
      case_when(
        ind_bet_hit_current == 1 ~ stake_current_total * (dec_odds_current_total - 1),
        ind_bet_hit_current == 0 ~ -stake_current_total
      )
  ) 
  
df_spreads_profit_2025 =

  mutate(
    home_odds = -112,

    home_odds_current = -112, 
    away_odds_current = -112,
    p_home = map_dbl(spread_sim_adj, ~ mean(.x > spread_line, na.rm = T)),
    p_away = 1 - p_home,
    p_home_current = map_dbl(spread_sim_adj, ~ mean(.x > spread_line_current, na.rm = T)),
    p_away_current = 1 - p_home_current,
    odds_home_dec =
      if_else(
        home_odds < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(home_odds),
        1 + home_odds / 100
      ),
    odds_away_dec =
      if_else(
        away_odds < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(away_odds),
        1 + away_odds / 100
      ),
    odds_home_current_dec =
      if_else(
        home_odds_current < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(home_odds_current),
        1 + home_odds_current / 100
      ),
    odds_away_current_dec =
      if_else(
        away_odds_current < 0,
        1 + 100 / abs(away_odds_current),
        1 + away_odds_current / 100
      ),
    ev_home  = p_home  * (odds_home_dec  - 1) - (1 - p_home),
    ev_away = p_away * (odds_away_dec - 1) - (1 - p_away),
    ev_home_current  = p_home_current  * (odds_home_current_dec  - 1) - (1 - p_home_current),
    ev_away_current = p_away_current * (odds_away_current_dec - 1) - (1 - p_away_current),
    bet_spread =
      case_when(
        ev_home  > 0.03 ~ "Bet Home",
        ev_away > 0.03 ~ "Bet Away",
        .default = "No Bet"
      ),
    bet_spread_current =
      case_when(
        ev_home_current  > 0.03 ~ "Bet Home",
        ev_away_current > 0.03 ~ "Bet Away",
        .default = "No Bet"
      ),
    ev_max_spread = pmax(ev_home, ev_away),
    ev_max_current_spread = pmax(ev_home_current, ev_away_current),
    side_spread = case_when(
      p_home  * odds_home_dec  > p_away * odds_away_dec  ~ "Home",
      p_away * odds_away_dec > p_home  * odds_home_dec  ~ "Away",
      .default = NA
    ),
    side_current_spread = case_when(
      p_home_current  * odds_home_current_dec  > p_away_current * odds_away_current_dec  ~ "Home",
      p_away_current * odds_away_current_dec > p_home_current  * odds_home_current_dec  ~ "Away",
      .default = NA
    ),
    p_spread = if_else(side_spread == "Home",  p_home,  p_away),
    p_current_spread = if_else(side_current_spread == "Home",  p_home_current,  p_away_current),
    dec_odds_spread = if_else(side_spread == "Home", odds_home_dec, odds_away_dec),
    dec_odds_current_spread = if_else(side_current_spread == "Home", odds_home_current_dec, odds_away_current_dec),
    kelly_spread = (p_spread * dec_odds_spread - 1) / (dec_odds_spread - 1),
    kelly_current_spread = (p_current_spread * dec_odds_current_spread - 1) / (dec_odds_current_spread - 1),
    stake_frac_spread = pmin(0.03, 0.05 * pmax(kelly_spread, 0)),
    stake_frac_current_spread = pmin(0.03, 0.05 * pmax(kelly_current_spread, 0)),
    stake_spread = stake_frac_spread * 100,
    stake_current_spread = stake_frac_current_spread * 100
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # left_join(df_qb_cont_old %>% select(game_id, week, qb_cont), by = c("game_id", "week")) %>% 
  # group_by(game_id) %>%
  # filter(sum(qb_cont) == 2) %>%
  # ungroup() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # filter(stake_spread >= 0.5) %>%
  # filter(stake_current_spread >= 0.5) %>%
  mutate(
    ind_bet_hit =
      case_when(
        side_spread == "Away" & actual_spread < spread_line ~ 1,
        side_spread == "Home" & actual_spread > spread_line ~ 1,
        side_spread == "Away" & actual_spread == spread_line ~ NA,
        side_spread == "Home" & actual_spread == spread_line ~ NA,
        .default = 0
      ),
    ind_bet_hit_current =
      case_when(
        side_current_spread == "Away" & actual_spread < spread_line_current ~ 1,
        side_current_spread == "Home" & actual_spread > spread_line_current ~ 1,
        side_current_spread == "Away" & actual_spread == spread_line_current ~ NA,
        side_current_spread == "Home" & actual_spread == spread_line_current ~ NA,
        .default = 0
      ),
    profit =
      case_when(
        ind_bet_hit == 1 ~ stake_spread * (dec_odds_spread - 1),
        ind_bet_hit == 0 ~ -stake_spread
      ),
    profit_current =
      case_when(
        ind_bet_hit_current == 1 ~ stake_current_spread * (dec_odds_current_spread - 1),
        ind_bet_hit_current == 0 ~ -stake_current_spread
      )
  )
```

## RMSE - Model vs Vegas

```{r rmse}
rmse_total_line_week_df = 
  team_total_spread_rolling_df %>% 
  left_join(
    team_total_spread_rolling_df %>% 
      group_by(game_id) %>% 
      mutate(
        team_opp = 
          case_when(
            row_number() == 1 ~ lead(team),
            row_number() == 2 ~ lag(team),
            .default = NA
          )
      ) %>% 
      relocate(team_opp, .after = team) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(game_id, team_opp, starts_with("prior_"), qb_cont, rest_days, travel_km) %>% 
      rename_with(~ str_c(., "_opp"), everything() & -c(game_id, team_opp)) %>% 
      rename(team = team_opp),
    by = c("game_id", "team")
  ) %>% 
  # filter(season == 2021) %>% 
  filter(qb_cont == 1 & qb_cont_opp == 1) %>% 
  select(season, week, game_id, total_team, starts_with("prior_"), rest_days, rest_days_opp, travel_km, travel_km_opp) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    pred_total_team = predict(mod_total_team_svm, newdata = .)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(game_id, season, week) %>% 
  summarise(
    pred_total = sum(pred_total_team),
    actual_total = sum(total_team)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(field_game_df, by = c("game_id")) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(game_id, ends_with("_field"), division_game, international, wind, temp, actual_total, pred_total) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    pred_total_adj = predict(mod_total_correct_enet, newdata = .)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(szn_all %>% distinct(season, week, game_id, total_line), by = c("game_id")) %>% 
  mutate(
    resid_mod = actual_total - (pred_total + pred_total_adj),
    resid_line = actual_total - total_line
  ) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(season, week) %>% 
  summarise(
    rmse_mod = sqrt(sum(resid_mod ^ 2) / n()),
    rmse_line = sqrt(sum(resid_line ^ 2) / n())
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    rmse_diff = rmse_line - rmse_mod
  )

    by = c("game_id", "team")

  ) %>% 
  group_by(game_id, season, week) %>% 
  summarise(
    pred_total = sum(pred_total_team),
    actual_total = sum(total_team)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(field_game_df, by = c("game_id")) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(game_id, ends_with("_field"), division_game, international, wind, temp, actual_total, pred_total) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    pred_total_adj = predict(mod_total_correct_enet, newdata = .)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(szn_all %>% distinct(season, week, game_id, total_line), by = c("game_id")) %>% 
  mutate(
    resid_mod = actual_total - (pred_total + pred_total_adj),
    resid_line = actual_total - total_line
  ) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(season) %>% 
  summarise(
    rmse_mod = sqrt(sum(resid_mod ^ 2) / n()),
    rmse_line = sqrt(sum(resid_line ^ 2) / n())
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    rmse_diff = rmse_line - rmse_mod
  )
```

## Model Edge and CLV

```{r edge clv}
df_edge_clv_spreads = 
  df_spreads_profit_2024 %>% 
  rename(
    spread_line_open = spread_line,
    spread_line_close = spread_line_current
  ) %>% 
  select(game_id, stake_spread, spread_line_open, spread_line_close, spread_game_adj, actual_spread, profit) %>% 
  mutate(season = 2024) %>% 
  rbind(
    df_spreads_profit_2025 %>% 
      rename(
        spread_line_open = spread_line,
        spread_line_close = spread_line_current
      ) %>% 
      select(game_id, stake_spread, spread_line_open, spread_line_close, spread_game_adj, actual_spread, profit) %>% 
      mutate(season = 2025)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    spread_game_adj = round(spread_game_adj, 2),
    edge_open = spread_game_adj - spread_line_open,
    edge_open_bucket = 
      case_when(
        abs(edge_open) < 1 ~ "0 - 1",
        between(abs(edge_open), 1, 1.999) ~ "1 - 2",
        between(abs(edge_open), 2, 2.999) ~ "2 - 3",
        between(abs(edge_open), 3, 3.999) ~ "3 - 4",
        abs(edge_open) >= 4 ~ "4+",
       .default = NA
      ),
    edge_close = spread_game_adj - spread_line_close,
    clv = sign(edge_open) * (spread_line_close - spread_line_open),
    residual = spread_game_adj - actual_spread
  ) %>% 
  drop_na()

df_edge_clv_spreads %>% 
  filter(stake_spread >= 0.5) %>% 
  group_by(season, edge_open_bucket) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_bets = n(),
    mean_clv = mean(clv),
    roi = sum(profit)
  )

# Calibration plot:

df_edge_clv_spreads %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = spread_game_adj, y = residual)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~ season)

df_edge_clv_totals = 
  df_totals_profit_2024 %>% 
  rename(
    total_line_open = total_line,
    total_line_close = total_line_current
  ) %>% 
  select(game_id, stake_total, total_line_open, total_line_close, total_game_adj, actual_total, profit) %>% 
  mutate(season = 2024) %>% 
  mutate(total_line_open = as.double(total_line_open)) %>% 
  rbind(
    df_totals_profit_2025 %>% 
      rename(
        total_line_open = total_line,
        total_line_close = total_line_current
      ) %>% 
      select(game_id, stake_total, total_line_open, total_line_close, total_game_adj, actual_total, profit) %>% 
      mutate(season = 2025)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    total_game_adj = round(total_game_adj, 2),
    edge_open = total_game_adj - total_line_open,
    edge_open_bucket = 
      case_when(
        abs(edge_open) < 1 ~ "0 - 1",
        between(abs(edge_open), 1, 1.999) ~ "1 - 2",
        between(abs(edge_open), 2, 2.999) ~ "2 - 3",
        between(abs(edge_open), 3, 3.999) ~ "3 - 4",
        abs(edge_open) >= 4 ~ "4+",
       .default = NA
      ),
    edge_close = total_game_adj - total_line_close,
    clv = sign(edge_open) * (total_line_close - total_line_open),
    residual = total_game_adj - actual_total
  ) %>% 
  drop_na()

df_edge_clv_totals %>% 
  filter(stake_total >= 0.5) %>% 
  group_by(season, edge_open_bucket) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_bets = n(),
    mean_clv = mean(clv),
    roi = sum(profit)
  )

# Calibration plot:

df_edge_clv_totals %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = total_game_adj, y = residual)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~ season)
```

```{r get data}
  filter(season <= 2025) %>% 
  calculate_player_stats() %>% 
  filter(position == "WR") %>% 
  select(player_id, player_display_name, games) %>% 
  left_join(
    roster_all_df %>% 
      filter(position == "WR") %>% 
      rename(player_id = gsis_id) %>% 
      select(player_id, full_name, entry_year) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    season = 2026,
    years_exp = 2026 - entry_year,

        entry_year >= 2021 ~ years_exp * 17,

      ),
    games_missed_career = games_total - games,
    games_missed_rate = games_missed_career / years_exp
  ) %>% 
  select(season, player_id, games_missed_rate) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  drop_na()

  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(season, posteam) %>% 
  mutate(
    prop_play = n_play / sum(n_play)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(play_type == "pass") %>% 
  rename(
    team = posteam,
    pass_rate = prop_play,
    n_pass = n_play
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    n_pass = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ n_pass * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ n_pass,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(play_type)) %>% 
  rbind(
    tibble(
      season = 2026,
      team = szn_all %>% distinct(posteam) %>% drop_na() %>% pull(),
      pass_rate = NA,
      n_pass = NA
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(team, season) %>% 
  group_by(team) %>% 
  mutate(
    prior_pass_rate = lag(pass_rate),
    prior_n_pass = lag(n_pass)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_pass_rate, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_pass_rate.rds"))

df_qb_epa =

  group_by(season, posteam, passer, passer_id) %>% 
  drop_na(epa) %>% 
  summarize(sum_epa = sum(qb_epa, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  rename(player_id = passer_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    sum_epa = 
       case_when(
         season < 2021 ~ sum_epa * 17 / 16,
         season >= 2021 ~ sum_epa,
         .default = NA
       )
  )

df_qb_epa_teams =

  left_join(df_qb_epa, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    prior_qb_epa = lag(sum_epa),
    team = 
      case_when(
        team == "SD" ~ "LAC",
        team == "SL" ~ "LA",
        team == "OAK" ~ "LV",

      )

  ungroup() %>%

  # filter(prior_qb_epa == max(prior_qb_epa, na.rm = T)) %>%

  filter(season != 2016) %>%

  mutate(
    qb_new_team = 
      case_when(
        lag(team) != team ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(season, team, prior_qb_epa, qb_new_team) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_pass_rate %>% 
      select(season, team, prior_n_pass),
    by = c("season", "team")

          .default = NA

      )

df_rz_tar_wr =

  group_by(season, team, player_id) %>% 
  summarise(

  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
    df_rz_targets %>% 
      rename(
        team = posteam
      ) %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      summarise(
        rz_tar_team = n()
      ) %>% 
      ungroup(),
    by = c("season", "team")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    rz_tar = 
      case_when(
        n() > 1 ~ sum(rz_tar, na.rm = T),
        n() == 1 ~ rz_tar,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    rz_tar_share = rz_tar / rz_tar_team
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  mutate(rz_tar_share = mean(rz_tar_share, na.rm = T)) %>%

# predict rookie competition:
df_rookie_tar = 
  df_fan_wr_all %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_wr_all %>% 
      select(season, player_id, rookie_year, draft_number),
    by = c("player_id", "season")
  ) %>% 
  filter(rookie_year == season) %>% 
  mutate(position = "WR") %>% 
  rbind(
    df_fan_te_all %>% 
      left_join(
        df_roster_te_all %>% 
          select(season, player_id, rookie_year, draft_number),
        by = c("player_id", "season")
      ) %>% 
      filter(rookie_year == season) %>% 
      mutate(position = "TE")
  ) %>% 
  select(season, position, player_id, player_display_name, draft_number, targets) %>% 
  mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)) %>% 
  group_by(player_id, position, player_display_name, season, draft_number) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_tar = sum(targets)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

mod_rookie_tar_wr = 
  df_rookie_tar %>% 
  filter(position == "WR") %>% 
  gam(
    n_tar ~ s(draft_number),
    data = .,
    method = "REML"
  )

mod_rookie_tar_te = 
  df_rookie_tar %>% 
  filter(position == "TE") %>% 
  gam(
    n_tar ~ s(draft_number),
    data = .,
    method = "REML"
  )

df_rookie_tar_fin =
  df_rookie_tar %>% 
  filter(position == "WR") %>% 
  mutate(expect_tar = predict(mod_rookie_tar_wr)) %>% 
  rbind(
    df_rookie_tar %>% 
      filter(position == "TE") %>% 
      mutate(expect_tar = predict(mod_rookie_tar_te))
  ) %>% 
  select(season, player_id, expect_tar)

df_fan_wr_fin_pre =
  df_fan_wr_all %>% 
  filter(between(season, 2016, 2025)) %>% 
  select(season, recent_team, position, player_id, player_display_name, receptions, receiving_yards, receiving_air_yards, racr, air_yards_share, target_share, fpts) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id, player_display_name, position) %>% 
  mutate(
    games_missed = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ 16 - n(),
        season >= 2021 ~ 17 - n()
      ),
    sum_yards = sum(receiving_yards, na.rm = T),
    sum_rec = sum(receptions, na.rm = T),
    sum_fpts = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T) * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T),
        .default = NA
      ),
    fpts_game = sum_fpts / n(),
    mean_racr = mean(racr, na.rm = T),
    mean_air_yards_share = mean(air_yards_share, na.rm = T),
    mean_target_share = mean(target_share, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(season, player_id, player_display_name, position, starts_with("sum_"), fpts_game, starts_with("mean_"), games_missed) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(df_route_partic_wr, by = c("season", "player_id")) %>% 
  left_join(df_rz_tar_wr, by = c("season", "player_id", "team")) %>% 
  mutate(
    yprr = sum_yards / n_routes
  ) %>% 
  # group_by(season) %>% 
  # mutate(season_rank = rank(desc(sum_fpts))) %>% 
  # ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_wr_all %>% 
      select(season, player_id, team, birth_date, years_exp, draft_number) %>% 
      mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)),
    by = c("season", "player_id", "team")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25,
    team = 
      case_when(
        team == "SD" ~ "LAC",
        team == "SL" ~ "LA",
        team == "OAK" ~ "LV",
        .default = team
      )
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id, season) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  drop_na(team) %>% 
  left_join(df_qb_epa_teams, by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    # across(
    #   c(games_missed, mean_air_yards_share, mean_target_share, sum_fpts),
    #   ~ lag(.),
    #   .names = "prior_{col}"
    # ),
    across(
      c(games_missed, mean_air_yards_share, mean_target_share, n_routes, route_partic, yprr, rz_tar_share, sum_fpts, fpts_game),
      ~ case_when(
        row_number() == 2 ~ lag(replace_na(., 0)),
        row_number() == 3 ~ 0.65 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.35 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))),
        row_number() > 3 ~ 0.6 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.3 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))) + 0.1 * lag(lag(lag(replace_na(., 0)))),
        .default = NA
      ),
      .names = "prior_{col}"
    )#,
    # wr_new_team = 
    #   case_when(
    #     lag(team) != team ~ 1,
    #     .default = 0
    #   ),
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    prior_ays = prior_mean_air_yards_share,
    prior_tar_share = prior_mean_target_share,
    prior_fpts = prior_sum_fpts
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_wr_new_team, by = c("season", "team", "player_id")) %>% 
  mutate(
    new_qb_new_team = 
      as.factor(
        case_when(
          qb_new_team == 1 | wr_new_team == 1 ~ 1,
          .default = 0
        )
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_fan_wr_fin_pre, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fan_wr_fin_pre.rds"))

df_fan_wr_fin_all = 
  df_fan_wr_fin_pre %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_wr_all %>% 
      left_join(df_fan_wr_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_fan_wr_fin_pre %>% 
          select(season, player_id, prior_tar_share),
        by = c("player_id", "season")
      ) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_qb_epa_teams %>% 
          select(season, team, prior_n_pass),
        by = c("team", "season")
      ) %>% 
      rbind(
        df_roster_te_all %>% 
          left_join(df_fan_te_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
          select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
          mutate(
            ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
          ) %>% 
          group_by(player_id) %>% 
          arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
          mutate(
            prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
            prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
            prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
          ) %>% 
          ungroup() %>% 
          group_by(season, team) %>% 
          arrange(season, team) %>% 
          filter(season != 2016) %>% 
          left_join(
            df_fan_te_fin_pre %>% 
              select(season, player_id, prior_tar_share),
            by = c("player_id", "season")
          ) %>% 
          left_join(
            df_qb_epa_teams %>% 
              select(season, team, prior_n_pass),
            by = c("team", "season")
          )
      ) %>% 
      left_join(df_rookie_tar_fin, by = c("season", "player_id")) %>% 
      mutate(
        expect_tar_rookie = sum(expect_tar, na.rm = T),
        top_20_other = sum(prior_ind_top_20, na.rm = T) - prior_ind_top_20,
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T) - prior_fpts,
        expect_tar_other = sum(prior_tar_share * prior_n_pass, na.rm = T) - prior_tar_share * prior_n_pass + expect_tar_rookie
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(player_id, season, prior_fpts_other, prior_rank, expect_tar_other),
    by = c("player_id", "season")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(df_games_missed_all, by = c("player_id", "season"))# %>% 
  # filter(prior_rank <= 100 | (prior_rank > 100 & prior_games_missed > 8 & sum_fpts >= 100) | (is.na(prior_rank)))

saveRDS(df_fan_wr_fin_all, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fan_wr_fin_all.rds"))
```

```{r wr team prior}
    )

df_rz_eff = 
  szn_all %>%
  mutate(
    redzone =
      case_when(
        yardline_100 <= 20 & two_point_attempt == 1 ~ NA,
        yardline_100 <= 20 & extra_point_attempt == 1 ~ NA,
        yardline_100 <= 20 ~ 1,
        yardline_100 > 20 ~ 0,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>%
  select(season, game_id, drive, posteam, yardline_100, redzone, touchdown, extra_point_attempt, two_point_attempt) %>%
  group_by(season, game_id, posteam, drive) %>%
  mutate(
    n_drive = row_number(),
    n_drive_rz = ifelse(redzone == 1, n_drive, NA),
    redzone_start = ifelse(n_drive_rz == min(n_drive_rz, na.rm = T), 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(season, posteam) %>%
  summarise(
    redzone_trips = sum(redzone_start == 1, na.rm = T),
    redzone_tds = sum(redzone == 1 & touchdown == 1, na.rm = T),
    rz_eff = redzone_tds / redzone_trips
  ) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(team = posteam) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      season = 2026,
      team = szn_all %>% distinct(home_team) %>% pull()
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(team, season) %>% 
  group_by(team) %>% 
  mutate(
    prior_rz_eff = lag(rz_eff),
    prior_rz_trips = lag(redzone_trips)
  )

saveRDS(df_rz_eff, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_rz_eff.rds"))

df_def_epa_sos = 
  df_schedules_szn_all %>% 
  filter(game_type == "REG") %>% 
  select(season, week, game_id, home_team, away_team) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    c(home_team, away_team),
    names_to = "home_away",
    values_to = "team"
  ) %>%
  select(-home_away) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_schedules_szn_all %>% 
    select(season, week, game_id, home_team, away_team) %>% 
    pivot_longer(
      c(home_team, away_team),
      names_to = "home_away",
      values_to = "team"
    ) %>%
    select(-home_away) %>% 
    rename(team_opp = team),
    by = c("season", "week", "game_id")
  ) %>% 
  filter(team != team_opp) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_def_epa %>% 
      rename(team_opp = team),
    by = c("season", "team_opp")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season, team) %>% 
  summarise(
    def_pass_epa_sos = mean(prior_def_pass_epa, na.rm = T),
    def_rush_epa_sos = mean(prior_def_rush_epa, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_def_epa_sos, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_def_epa_sos.rds"))

df_feature_svm = readRDS("df_feature_svm_2026_07_04.rds")

df_fpts_wr_train = 
  df_fan_wr_fin_all %>% 
  filter(prior_rank <= 100 | (is.na(prior_rank)) | prior_fpts >= 85) %>% 
  left_join(df_off_epa, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_rz_eff, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_def_epa_sos, by = c("team", "season")) %>%
  # left_join(coach_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  # left_join(mod_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  select(player_id, sum_fpts, prior_ays, prior_tar_share, prior_fpts, prior_qb_epa, prior_n_pass, prior_off_pass_epa, def_pass_epa_sos, prior_rz_eff, prior_rz_trips, prior_n_routes, prior_route_partic, prior_yprr, prior_rz_tar_share, player_age, draft_number, prior_fpts_other, expect_tar_other, new_qb_new_team, prior_games_missed, games_missed_rate) %>% 
  mutate(
    expect_tar = prior_tar_share * prior_n_pass,
    expect_ay = prior_ays * prior_n_pass,
    expect_routes = prior_route_partic * prior_n_pass,
    expect_rz_opp = prior_rz_tar_share * prior_rz_trips
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(prior_games_missed, prior_rz_trips, prior_fpts_other, def_pass_epa_sos, expect_ay, expect_tar)) %>% 
  select(-any_of(df_feature_svm %>% filter(delta_rmse < -0.06) %>% pull(var_svm))) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  arrange(player_id) %>% 
  select(-player_id) %>% 
  relocate(sum_fpts, .after = last_col())

saveRDS(df_fpts_wr_train, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fpts_wr_train.rds"))

view(df_fpts_wr_train)

cor(df_fpts_wr_train %>% select(-new_qb_new_team))

  mod_glm_wr$pred %>% 
  tibble() %>% 
  select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
  mutate(model = "glm") %>% 
  # rbind(

  #     select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
  #     mutate(model = "enet")
  # ) %>% 
  # rbind(

  #     mutate(model = "knn")
  # ) %>% 
  # rbind(
  #   mod_mars_wr$pred %>% 
  #     tibble() %>% 
  #     select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
  #     mutate(model = "mars")
  # ) %>% 
  # rbind(
  #   mod_boost_wr$pred %>% 
  #     tibble() %>% 
  #     select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
  #     mutate(model = "boost")
  # ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_svm_wr$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "svm")
  ) %>%
  group_by(model, rowIndex) %>%
  summarise(
    actual = first(obs),
    pred_oof = mean(pred)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    residual = actual - pred_oof,
    abs_residual = abs(residual),
    squared_residual = residual^2,
    # mod_var = log(squared_residual + 1),
    mod_var = abs_residual
  )
```

### Make model for rookies

```{r wr rookie}
df_fpts_wr_rookie_train =
  df_roster_wr_all %>% 
  filter(rookie_year == season) %>% 
  select(season, player_id, full_name, team, birth_date, draft_number) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25,
    team = 
      case_when(
        team == "SD" ~ "LAC",
        team == "OAK" ~ "LV",
        .default = team
      )
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(team) %>% 
  left_join(df_qb_epa_teams, by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_fan_wr_all %>% 
      select(season, position, player_id, player_display_name, fpts) %>% 
      group_by(season, player_id, player_display_name, position) %>% 
      mutate(
        sum_fpts = 
          case_when(
            season < 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T) * 17 / 16,
            season >= 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T),
            .default = NA
          )
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(season, player_id, sum_fpts) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = c("season", "player_id")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_wr_all %>% 
      left_join(df_fan_wr_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(season, team, prior_fpts_other) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = c("season", "team")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_wr_all %>% 
      left_join(df_fan_wr_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_fan_wr_fin_pre %>% 
          select(season, player_id, prior_tar_share),
        by = c("player_id", "season")
      ) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_qb_epa_teams %>% 
          select(season, team, prior_n_pass),
        by = c("team", "season")
      ) %>% 
      rbind(
        df_roster_te_all %>% 
          left_join(df_fan_te_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
          select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
          mutate(
            ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
          ) %>% 
          group_by(player_id) %>% 
          arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
          mutate(
            prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
            prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
            prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
          ) %>% 
          ungroup() %>% 
          group_by(season, team) %>% 
          arrange(season, team) %>% 
          filter(season != 2016) %>% 
          left_join(
            df_fan_te_fin_pre %>% 
              select(season, player_id, prior_tar_share),
            by = c("player_id", "season")
          ) %>% 
          left_join(
            df_qb_epa_teams %>% 
              select(season, team, prior_n_pass),
            by = c("team", "season")
          )
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      summarise(
        expect_tar_other = sum(prior_tar_share * prior_n_pass, na.rm = T)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup(),
    by = c("season", "team")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)
  ) %>% 
  # left_join(fin_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  # left_join(coach_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  group_by(season) %>%
  arrange(season, draft_number) %>% 
  slice_min(draft_number, n = 15) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(df_off_epa, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_rz_eff, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_ol_cont_team, by = c("team", "season")) %>%
  # left_join(coach_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  # left_join(mod_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  select(player_id, sum_fpts, prior_qb_epa, prior_n_pass, prior_off_pass_epa, prior_rz_eff, prior_rz_trips, prior_fpts_other, expect_tar_other, player_age, draft_number, ol_cont_grade_pass) %>% 
  select(-c(prior_off_pass_epa, prior_rz_trips, prior_rz_eff, prior_fpts_other, ol_cont_grade_pass)) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  arrange(player_id) %>%
  select(-player_id)

df_oof_pred_wr_rook = 
  mod_glm_wr_rook$pred %>% 
  tibble() %>% 
  select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
  mutate(model = "glm") %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_enet_wr_rook$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "enet")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_knn_wr_rook$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "knn")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_mars_wr_rook$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "mars")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_boost_wr_rook$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "boost")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_svm_wr_rook$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "svm")
  ) %>%
  group_by(model, rowIndex) %>%
  summarise(
    actual = first(obs),
    pred_oof = mean(pred)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    residual = actual - pred_oof,
    abs_residual = abs(residual),
    squared_residual = residual^2,
    mod_var = log(squared_residual + 1),
    mod_var = abs_residual
  )

df_mod_resid_wr_rook =

  filter(model == "boost") %>% 
  cbind(df_fpts_wr_rookie_train) %>%

# Calibration:
df_resid_wr_train_rook %>%
  cbind(
    df_fpts_wr_rookie_train %>%
      select(sum_fpts)
  ) %>%
  tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    mod_pred_fpts = predict(mod_boost_wr_rook, newdata = df_fpts_wr_rookie_train),
    mod_pred_resid = predict(mod_knn_wr_rook_resid, newdata = df_resid_wr_train_rook),
    # mod_pred_var = exp(mod_pred_resid) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # mod_pred_sd = sqrt(mod_pred_var),
    residual = sum_fpts - mod_pred_fpts,
    mod_pred_sd = mod_pred_resid * sqrt(pi / 2),
    # mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5)
  ) %>%
  group_by(mod_pred_sd_quant) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sd = mean(mod_pred_sd),
    resid_sd = sd(residual)
  )

# coverage:
df_resid_wr_train_rook %>%
  cbind(
    df_fpts_wr_rookie_train %>%
      select(sum_fpts)
  ) %>%
  tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    mod_pred_fpts = predict(mod_boost_wr_rook, newdata = df_fpts_wr_rookie_train),
    mod_pred_resid = predict(mod_knn_wr_rook_resid, newdata = df_resid_wr_train_rook),
    # mod_pred_var = exp(mod_pred_resid) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # mod_pred_sd = sqrt(mod_pred_var),
    residual = sum_fpts - mod_pred_fpts,
    mod_pred_sd = mod_pred_resid * sqrt(pi / 2),
    # mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    cov_1sd =
      case_when(
        abs(residual) <= mod_pred_sd ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      ),
    cov_2sd =
      case_when(
        abs(residual) <= 2 * mod_pred_sd ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      )
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cov_1sd = mean(cov_1sd),
    cov_2sd = mean(cov_2sd)
  )
```

```{r pred test}
df_fpts_wr_test_pre =
  df_roster_wr_all %>% 
  filter(season %in% c(2025, 2026)) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    # wr_new_team = 
    #   case_when(
    #     lag(team) != team ~ 1,
    #     .default = 0
    #   ),
    draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(season %in% 2026) %>% 
  mutate(player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_fan_wr_fin_all %>% 
      filter(season %in% c(2023, 2024, 2025)) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      select(-expect_tar_other) %>% 
      drop_na(player_age) %>% 
      distinct() %>% 
      mutate(
        across(
          c(games_missed, mean_air_yards_share, mean_target_share, n_routes, route_partic, yprr, rz_tar_share, sum_fpts, fpts_game),
          ~ case_when(
            row_number() == 1 ~ replace_na(., 0),
            row_number() == 2 ~ 0.65 * replace_na(., 0) + 0.35 * lag(replace_na(., 0)),
            row_number() == 3 ~ 0.6 * replace_na(., 0) + 0.3 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.1 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))),
            .default = NA
          ),
          .names = "prior_{col}"
        )
      ) %>% 
      select(-c(prior_ays, prior_tar_share, prior_fpts)) %>% 
      rename(
        prior_ays = prior_mean_air_yards_share,
        prior_tar_share = prior_mean_target_share,
        prior_fpts = prior_sum_fpts
      ) %>% 
      filter(season == 2025) %>% 
      select(player_id, player_display_name, prior_ays, prior_tar_share, prior_fpts, prior_fpts_game, prior_route_partic, prior_yprr),
    by = "player_id"
  )

        df_roster_te_all %>% 
          left_join(df_fan_te_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
          select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
          mutate(
            ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
          ) %>% 
          group_by(player_id) %>% 
          arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
          mutate(
            prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
            prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
            prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
          ) %>% 
          ungroup() %>% 
          group_by(season, team) %>% 
          arrange(season, team) %>% 
          filter(season != 2016) %>% 
          left_join(
            df_fpts_te_test_pre %>% 
              select(season, player_id, prior_tar_share),
            by = c("player_id", "season")
          ) %>% 
          left_join(
            df_qb_epa_teams %>% 
              select(season, team, prior_n_pass),
            by = c("team", "season")
          )
      ) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_roster_wr_all %>% 
          filter(rookie_year == 2026) %>% 
          mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)) %>% 
          mutate(expect_tar = predict(mod_rookie_tar_wr, newdata = .)) %>% 
          rbind(
            df_roster_te_all %>% 
              filter(rookie_year == 2026) %>% 
              mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)) %>% 
              mutate(expect_tar = predict(mod_rookie_tar_te, newdata = .))
          ) %>% 
          select(player_id, expect_tar), 
        by = c("player_id")
      ) %>% 
      mutate(
        expect_tar_rookie = sum(expect_tar, na.rm = T),
        top_20_other = sum(prior_ind_top_20, na.rm = T) - prior_ind_top_20,
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T) - prior_fpts,
        expect_tar_other = sum(prior_tar_share * prior_n_pass, na.rm = T) - prior_tar_share * prior_n_pass + expect_tar_rookie
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, prior_fpts_other, prior_rank, expect_tar_other) %>% 
      filter(season == 2026),
    by = c("season", "player_id", "team")
  ) %>% 
  # left_join(
  #   coach_df %>% 
  #     filter(season == 2026) %>% 
  #     select(season, team, coach_exp_off),
  #   by = c("season", "team")
  # ) %>% 
  left_join(df_qb_epa_teams, by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  left_join(df_wr_new_team, by = c("season", "team", "player_id")) %>% 
  mutate(
    new_qb_new_team = 
      as.factor(
        case_when(
          qb_new_team == 1 | wr_new_team == 1 ~ 1,
          .default = 0
        )
      )
  ) %>% 
  # filter(prior_rank <= 100 | (prior_rank > 100 & prior_games_missed > 8 | (is.na(prior_rank)))) %>% 
  left_join(df_games_missed_all, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_def_epa_sos, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  filter(prior_rank <= 110 | is.na(prior_rank) | prior_fpts >= 85) %>% 
  mutate(
    expect_tar = prior_tar_share * prior_n_pass,
    expect_ay = prior_ays * prior_n_pass,
    expect_routes = prior_route_partic * prior_n_pass,
    # expect_rz_opp = prior_rz_tar_share * prior_rz_trips
  ) %>% 
  select(player_id, player_display_name, team, prior_ays, prior_tar_share, games_missed_rate, prior_fpts, prior_n_pass, player_age, draft_number, expect_tar_other, new_qb_new_team, expect_tar, expect_ay, expect_routes, prior_yprr, def_pass_epa_sos) %>% 
  # select(-c(prior_qb_epa)) %>% 
  drop_na()

      group_by(season, team) %>%

          ) %>% 
          ungroup() %>% 
          group_by(season, team) %>% 
          arrange(season, team) %>% 
          filter(season != 2016) %>% 
          left_join(
            df_fpts_te_test_pre %>% 
              select(season, player_id, prior_tar_share),
            by = c("player_id", "season")
          ) %>% 
          left_join(

set.seed(37564)
df_fpts_wr_sim =
  df_fpts_wr_test %>% 
  mutate(
    pred_fpts_svm = predict(mod_svm_wr, newdata = df_fpts_wr_test),
    pred_resid_enet = predict(mod_enet_wr_resid, newdata = df_fpts_wr_test)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  arrange(-pred_fpts_svm) %>% 
  rowid_to_column("wr_rank_svm") %>% 
  select(wr_rank_svm, team, player_id, player_display_name, pred_fpts_svm, pred_resid_enet) %>% 
  mutate(
    # pred_var_knn = exp(pred_resid_knn) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # pred_sd_knn = sqrt(pred_var_knn),
    pred_sd_enet = pred_resid_enet * sqrt(pi / 2),
    # pred_sd_knn = sqrt(exp(pred_resid_knn) - 1)
    fpts_sim = 
      map2(
        .x = pred_fpts_svm,
        .y = pred_sd_enet,
        ~ rnorm(10000, mean = .x, sd = .y)
      )
  ) %>% 
  separate_longer_delim(fpts_sim, delim = ",") %>% 
  mutate(fpts_sim = as.double(str_remove(fpts_sim, "^c\\("))) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_sim_ind = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_fpts_wr_sim, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fpts_wr_sim.rds"))

set.seed(37564)
df_fpts_wr_rook_sim =
  df_fpts_wr_rookie_test %>% 
  rename(player_display_name = full_name) %>% 
  mutate(
    pred_fpts_boost = predict(mod_boost_wr_rook, newdata = df_fpts_wr_rookie_test),
    pred_resid_knn = predict(mod_knn_wr_rook_resid, newdata = df_fpts_wr_rookie_test)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  arrange(-pred_fpts_boost) %>% 
  rowid_to_column("wr_rank_boost") %>% 
  select(wr_rank_boost, team, player_id, player_display_name, pred_fpts_boost, pred_resid_knn) %>% 
  mutate(
    # pred_var_knn = exp(pred_resid_knn) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # pred_sd_knn = sqrt(pred_var_knn),
    pred_sd_knn = pred_resid_knn * sqrt(pi / 2),
    # pred_sd_knn = sqrt(exp(pred_resid_knn) - 1)
    fpts_sim = 
      map2(
        .x = pred_fpts_boost,
        .y = pred_sd_knn,
        ~ rnorm(10000, mean = .x, sd = .y)
      )
  ) %>% 
  separate_longer_delim(fpts_sim, delim = ",") %>% 
  mutate(fpts_sim = as.double(str_remove(fpts_sim, "^c\\("))) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_sim_ind = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

df_fpts_wr_sim_fin = 
  df_fpts_wr_sim %>% 
  bind_rows(
    df_fpts_wr_rook_sim
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_sim_ind) %>% 
  arrange(player_sim_ind, -fpts_sim) %>% 
  mutate(
    fpts_sim_rank = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_fpts_wr_rook_sim, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fpts_wr_rook_sim.rds"))

df_wr_project_fin =
  df_fpts_wr_sim_fin %>%
  left_join(
    df_fpts_wr_sim_fin %>% 
      distinct(player_id, pred_fpts_svm, pred_fpts_boost) %>% 
      mutate(
        pred_fpts_fin = 
          case_when(
            is.na(pred_fpts_svm) ~ pred_fpts_boost,
            .default = pred_fpts_svm
          )
      ) %>% 
      arrange(-pred_fpts_fin) %>% 
      rowid_to_column("wr_rank_fin") %>% 
      select(player_id, wr_rank_fin, pred_fpts_fin),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    top_1 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank == 1, 1, 0),
    top_5 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 5, 1, 0),
    top_12 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 12, 1, 0),
    top_24 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 24, 1, 0),
    top_36 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 36, 1, 0),
    # below_30 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank > 30, 1, 0),
    below_50 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank > 50, 1, 0),
    pred_fpts = round(pred_fpts_fin, 1)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id, team, wr_rank_fin, player_display_name, pred_fpts) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      c(starts_with("top_"), starts_with("below_")),
      ~ sum(.) / 10000,
      .names = "prop_{col}"
    ),
    pred_rank_med = median(fpts_sim_rank),
    pred_rank_mean = mean(fpts_sim_rank),
    pred_rank_90p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.1),
    pred_rank_80p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.2),
    pred_rank_20p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.8),
    pred_rank_10p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.9)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
    df_fpts_wr_sim_fin %>% 
      group_by(player_id, team, player_display_name) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, team, player_display_name, fpts_sim) %>% 
      mutate(
        fpts_sim_quant = ntile(fpts_sim, n = 20),
        fpts_sim_quant_rank = row_number()
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      filter(fpts_sim_quant_rank %in% c(1000, 2000, 5000, 8000, 9000)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = fpts_sim_quant_rank,
        names_prefix = "quant_",
        values_from = fpts_sim
      ) %>% 
      rename(
        pred_fpts_med = quant_5000,
        pred_fpts_90p = quant_9000,
        pred_fpts_80p = quant_8000,
        pred_fpts_20p = quant_2000,
        pred_fpts_10p = quant_1000
      ) %>% 
      mutate(across(starts_with("pred_"), ~ round(ifelse(. < 0, 0, .), 1))) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      fill(starts_with("pred_"), .direction = "downup") %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(player_id, pred_fpts_med, starts_with("pred_fpts_") & ends_with("p")) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  # select(-player_id) %>% 
  relocate(pred_fpts_med, starts_with("pred_fpts_") & ends_with("p"), .after = pred_fpts)

saveRDS(df_wr_project_fin, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_wr_project_fin.rds"))

# from: https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/adp/ppr-overall.php
df_adp =
  read.csv(str_c("data/raw_data/fantasy_adp/", "FantasyPros_2026_Overall_ADP_Rankings_2026_07_28.csv")) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  tibble() %>% 
  rename(
    # player_display_name = player_bye,
    pos_rank_adp = pos,
    adp = avg
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_display_name = str_trim(str_remove(player_bye, "[A-Z]+ \\(\\d+\\)$")),
    player_display_name = 
      case_match(
        player_display_name, 
        "Michael Pittman Jr." ~ "Michael Pittman",
        "Joshua Palmer" ~ "Josh Palmer",
        "Tre' Harris" ~ "Tre Harris",
        "James Cook III" ~ "James Cook",
        "Aaron Jones Sr." ~ "Aaron Jones",
        "Travis Etienne Jr." ~ "Travis Etienne",
        "Brian Robinson Jr." ~ "Brian Robinson",
        "Audric Estime" ~ "Audric Estimé",
        "Kyle Pitts Sr." ~ "Kyle Pitts",
        "Hollywood Brown" ~ "Marquise Brown",
        "Patrick Mahomes II" ~ "Patrick Mahomes",
        "KC Concepcion" ~ "K.C. Concepcion",
        "Omar Cooper Jr." ~ "Omar Cooper",
        "Ted Hurst III" ~ "Ted Hurst",
        "Chris Brazzell II" ~ "Chris Brazzell II",
        "Mike Washington Jr." ~ "Mike Washington",
        .default = player_display_name
      ),
    team = str_extract(str_extract(player_bye, "[A-Z]+ \\(\\d+\\)$"), "^[A-Z]+"), 
    team = 
      case_when(
        team == "LAR" ~ "LA",
        team == "JAC" ~ "JAX",
        .default = team
      )
  )

df_wr_project_fin_adp = 
  df_wr_project_fin %>%
  left_join(
    df_adp,
    by = c("team", "player_display_name")
  ) %>% 
  #filter(is.na(avg))
  mutate(
    adp = as.integer(str_extract(pos_rank_adp, "\\d+")),
    rank_edge = adp - wr_rank_fin
  )

market_curve_wr = 
  df_wr_project_fin_adp %>% 
  drop_na(rank_edge) %>% 
  gam(
    pred_fpts ~ s(adp),
    data = .,
    method = "REML"
  )

df_wr_project_market = 
  df_wr_project_fin_adp %>%
  mutate(
    market_proj =
      predict(
        market_curve_wr,
        newdata = .
      ),
    market_edge = pred_fpts - market_proj,
    exp_finish_edge = adp - pred_rank_mean
  )

# view(df_wr_project_market)

df_adp_beat_wr = 
  df_fpts_wr_sim_fin %>% 
  left_join(
    df_wr_project_fin_adp %>% 
      select(team, player_display_name, adp),
    by = c("team", "player_display_name")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    prop_adp_beat = mean(fpts_sim_rank < adp)
  )

df_wr_project_market_fin = 
  df_wr_project_market %>% 
  left_join(df_adp_beat_wr, by = "player_id")

# view(df_wr_project_market_fin)

df_wr_fantasy_table =
  df_wr_project_market_fin %>% 
  mutate(
    across(c(market_proj, market_edge, pred_rank_med, exp_finish_edge), ~ round(., 1))
  ) %>% 
  rename(rank_mod = wr_rank_fin) %>% 
  select(player_display_name, team, rank_mod, adp, rank_edge, pred_rank_med, pred_fpts, market_proj, market_edge, prop_adp_beat, pred_fpts_10p, pred_fpts_90p, starts_with("prop_")) %>% 
  select(-c(prop_top_1, prop_top_5)) %>%

    "player_display_name" = "Player",

    "rank_mod" = "Rank", 
    "adp" = "ADP", 
    "rank_edge" = "Rank Edge", 
    "pred_rank_med" = "Median Finish", 
    "pred_fpts" = "Model Projection", 
    "market_proj" = "Market Projection", 
    "market_edge" = "Market Edge", 
    "prop_adp_beat" = "Beat ADP", 
    "pred_fpts_10p" = "Floor", 
    "pred_fpts_90p" = "Ceiling", 
    "prop_top_12" = "WR12", 
    "prop_top_24" = "WR24", 
    "prop_top_36" = "WR36", 
    "prop_below_50" = ">WR50"
  )

prob_pal =
  scales::col_numeric(
    palette = c("#d73027", "#fee08b", "#1a9850"),
    domain = c(0, 1)
  )

edge_pal =
  scales::col_numeric(
    palette = c("#d73027", "#fee08b", "#1a9850"),
    domain = c(-130, 130)
  )

reactable(
  df_wr_fantasy_table,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 100,
  defaultSorted = "wr_rank_svm",
  defaultSortOrder = "asc",
  columns = list(

    player_display_name = colDef(
      name = "Player",
      minWidth = 100
    ),

    team = colDef(
      name = "Team",
      minWidth = 45
    ),

    wr_rank_svm = colDef(
      name = "Rank",
      minWidth = 45
    ),

    adp_wr = colDef(
      name = "ADP",
      minWidth = 45
    ),

    rank_edge_wr = colDef(
      name = "Rank Edge",
      style = function(value) {
      
        text_color <- ifelse(value > .55, "white", "black")
      
        list(
          background = edge_pal(value),
          color = text_color,
          fontWeight = "bold"
        )
      },
      minWidth = 60
    ),
    
    pred_fpts = colDef(
      name = "Model Projection",
      minWidth = 60
    ),
    
    market_proj_wr = colDef(
      name = "Market Projection",
      minWidth = 60
    ),

    market_edge_wr = colDef(
      name = "Projection Edge",
      style = function(value) {
      
        text_color <- ifelse(value > .55, "white", "black")
      
        list(
          background = edge_pal(value),
          color = text_color,
          fontWeight = "bold"
        )
      },
      minWidth = 60
    ),
    
    pred_rank_mean = colDef(
      name = "Mean finish",
      minWidth = 60
    ),

df_fpts_wr_sim %>% 
  group_by(player_id, team, player_display_name) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, team, player_display_name, fpts_sim) %>% 
  mutate(
    fpts_sim_quant = ntile(fpts_sim, n = 20),
    fpts_sim_quant_rank = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(fpts_sim_quant_rank %in% c(2000, 5000, 8000)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = fpts_sim_quant_rank,
    names_prefix = "quant_",
    values_from = fpts_sim
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    pred_med = quant_5000,
    pred_upper = quant_8000,
    pred_lower = quant_2000
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  fill(starts_with("pred_"), .direction = "downup") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-player_sim_ind) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(
    # pred_upper = 
    #   case_when(
    #     fpts_sim_quant_rank == 9000 ~ fpts_sim,
    #     .default = NA
    #   ),
    player_display_name = str_c(wr_rank_svm, ". ", player_display_name)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    teams_colors_logos %>% 
      rename(team = team_abbr) %>% 
      select(team, team_color), 
    by = "team"
  ) %>% 
  filter(wr_rank_svm <= 50) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(player_display_name, -wr_rank_svm), x = pred_med)) + 
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = pred_lower, xmax = pred_upper, color = team_color), height = 1) +
  # geom_boxplot(aes(color = team_color), size = 0.85) +
  geom_point(aes(color = team_color), size = 2.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = player_display_name, x = pred_upper + 1, color = team_color), hjust = 0, size = 3.15)+
  scale_color_identity() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 450, by = 25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted Fantasy Points (PPR)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "WR Fantasy Point Predictions"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off",
    xlim = c(75, 400)
  )

set.seed(37564)
boot_splits = bootstraps(fpts_wr_train_df, times = 100)

# 2. Predict for each bootstrap model
boot_preds = map(boot_splits$splits, ~ {
  train_data = analysis(.x)
  
  # Train SVM model
  svm_model = train(
    sum_fpts ~ ., 
    data = train_data,
    method = "svmRadial",
    trControl = trainControl(method = "none"),  # already tuned
    tuneGrid = tibble(
      sigma = mod_svm_wr$bestTune[[1]],
      C = mod_svm_wr$bestTune[[2]]
    )
  )
  
  # Predict on the fixed test set
  predict(svm_model, newdata = fpts_wr_test_df)
})

# 3. Combine predictions into a matrix
pred_matrix = do.call(cbind, boot_preds)

# 4. Compute mean prediction and 95% prediction interval
wr_boot_pred_bands = 
  fpts_wr_test_df %>%
  select(player_id, full_name) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_mean  = round(rowMeans(pred_matrix), 2), 
    pred_lower = round(apply(pred_matrix, 1, quantile, probs = 0.1), 2),
    pred_upper = round(apply(pred_matrix, 1, quantile, probs = 0.9), 2),
  )

view(wr_boot_pred_bands)

set.seed(37564)
boot_splits_rook = bootstraps(fpts_wr_rookie_train_df, times = 100)

# Fit model to each resample and generate predictions
boot_preds_rook = 
  boot_splits_rook %>%
  mutate(
    preds = 
      map(
        splits, 
        ~ {
          model = earth(sum_fpts ~ ., data = analysis(.x), nprune = mod_mars_wr_rook$bestTune[[1]], degree = mod_mars_wr_rook$bestTune[[2]])
    predict(model, fpts_wr_rookie_test_df)
      }
    )
  )

# Convert predictions into long-format tibble
wr_boot_pred_bands_rook = 
  boot_preds_rook %>%
  select(preds) %>%
  unnest_longer(preds, indices_to = "player_index") %>%
  group_by(player_index) %>%
  summarise(
    pred_mean = mean(preds),
    pred_lower = quantile(preds, 0.10),
    pred_upper = quantile(preds, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    full_name = fpts_wr_rookie_test_df$full_name[player_index],
    player_id = fpts_wr_rookie_test_df$player_id[player_index],
    across(c(pred_mean, pred_lower, pred_upper), ~ round(., 2))
  ) %>%
  select(player_id, full_name, pred_mean, pred_lower, pred_upper)

view(wr_boot_pred_bands_rook)

fpts_wr_2025_fin_rank = 
  fpts_wr_2025 %>% 
  left_join(
    wr_boot_pred_bands %>% 
      rbind(wr_boot_pred_bands_rook), 
    by = c("player_id", "full_name")
  )

view(fpts_wr_2025_fin_rank)
```

```{r get data rb}
df_games_missed_rb_2026 = 
  szn_all %>% 
  filter(season <= 2025) %>% 
  calculate_player_stats() %>% 
  filter(position == "RB") %>% 
  select(player_id, player_display_name, games) %>% 
  left_join(
    roster_all_df %>% 
      filter(position == "RB") %>% 
      rename(player_id = gsis_id) %>% 
      select(player_id, full_name, entry_year) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    season = 2026,
    years_exp = 2026 - entry_year,
    games_total = 
      case_when(
        entry_year >= 2021 ~ years_exp * 17,
        entry_year < 2021 ~ (years_exp - (2026 - 2021)) * 16 + (2026 - 2021) * 17,
        .default = NA
      ),
    games_missed_career = games_total - games,
    games_missed_rate = games_missed_career / years_exp
  ) %>% 
  select(season, player_id, games_missed_rate) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  drop_na()

df_games_missed_rb_2020 = 
  szn_all %>% 
  filter(season <= 2019) %>% 
  calculate_player_stats() %>% 
  filter(position == "RB") %>% 
  select(player_id, player_display_name, games) %>% 
  left_join(
    roster_all_df %>% 
      filter(position == "RB") %>% 
      rename(player_id = gsis_id) %>% 
      select(player_id, full_name, entry_year) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    season = 2020,
    years_exp = 2020 - entry_year,
    games_total = 
      case_when(
        entry_year < 2021 ~ years_exp * 16,
        .default = NA
      ),
    games_missed_career = games_total - games,
    games_missed_rate = games_missed_career / years_exp
  ) %>% 
  select(season, player_id, games_missed_rate) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  drop_na()

df_rush_rate =
  szn_all %>% 
  filter(between(season, 2016, 2026)) %>% 
  select(season, posteam, play_type, qb_scramble) %>% 
  filter(play_type %in% c("pass", "run", "punt") & qb_scramble != 1) %>% 
  group_by(season, posteam, play_type) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_play = n()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(season, posteam) %>% 
  mutate(
    prop_play = n_play / sum(n_play)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(play_type == "run") %>% 
  rename(
    team = posteam,
    rush_rate = prop_play,
    n_rush_team = n_play
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    n_rush_team = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ n_rush_team * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ n_rush_team,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(play_type)) %>% 
  rbind(
    tibble(
      season = 2026,
      team = szn_all %>% distinct(posteam) %>% drop_na() %>% pull(),
      rush_rate = NA,
      n_rush_team = NA
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(team, season) %>% 
  group_by(team) %>% 
  mutate(
    prior_rush_rate = lag(rush_rate),
    prior_n_rush_team = lag(n_rush_team)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_rush_rate, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_rush_rate.rds"))

view(df_rush_rate)

        team == "SD" ~ "LAC",

      ),

df_fan_rb_season_finish = 
  df_fan_rb_all %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    fpts_total = sum(fpts)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    fpts_total = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ fpts_total * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ fpts_total,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season) %>% 
  arrange(season, desc(fpts_total)) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    season_rank = row_number(),
    season_finish = 
      factor(
        case_when(
          between(season_rank, 1, 20) ~ "Top 20",
          between(season_rank, 21, 50) ~ "21 - 50",
          season_rank > 50 ~ "Over 50",
          .default = NA
        ),
        levels = c("Top 20", "21 - 50", "Over 50")
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()
  
saveRDS(df_fan_rb_season_finish, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fan_rb_season_finish.rds"))

view(df_fan_rb_season_finish)

df_gl_trips = 
  szn_all %>% 
  filter(between(season, 2016, 2025)) %>% 
  filter(
    rush == 1 & yardline_100 <= 5 & !is.na(rusher_player_id)
  )
    
saveRDS(df_gl_trips, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_gl_trips.rds"))

df_gl_att_rb = 
  df_gl_trips %>% 
  rename(
    team = posteam,
    player_id = rusher_player_id
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season, team, player_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    gl_att = n()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
    df_gl_trips %>% 
      rename(
        team = posteam
      ) %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      summarise(
        gl_att_team = n()
      ) %>% 
      ungroup(),
    by = c("season", "team")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    gl_att = 
      case_when(
        n() > 1 ~ sum(gl_att, na.rm = T),
        n() == 1 ~ gl_att,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    gl_att_share = gl_att / gl_att_team
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  mutate(gl_att_share = mean(gl_att_share, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup()
    
saveRDS(df_gl_att_rb, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_gl_att_rb.rds"))

df_participation_rb = 
  df_participation %>% 
  filter(!is.na(offense_players) & offense_players != "") %>% 
  separate_longer_delim(offense_players, delim = ";") %>% 
  rename(
    player_id = offense_players,
    game_id = nflverse_game_id
  ) %>% 
  right_join(
    df_roster_rb_all %>% 
      distinct(position, player_id),
    by = "player_id"
  )    

saveRDS(df_participation_rb, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_participation_rb.rds"))

# view(df_participation_wr)

df_route_partic_rb =
  df_participation_rb %>% 
  left_join(
    szn_all %>% 
      select(season, posteam, game_id, play_id, pass),
    by = c("game_id", "play_id")
  ) %>% 
  filter(pass == 1) %>% 
  rename(team = posteam) %>% 
  group_by(season, team, player_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_routes = n()
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    n_routes = 
      case_when(
        n() > 1 ~ sum(n_routes, na.rm = T),
        n() == 1 ~ n_routes,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    n_routes = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ n_routes * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ n_routes,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(df_pass_rate %>% select(season, team, n_pass), by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  mutate(
    route_partic = n_routes / n_pass
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  mutate(route_partic = mean(route_partic, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_route_partic_rb, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_route_partic_rb.rds"))
```
