```{r get data rb}
# predict rookie competition:
df_rookie_rush = 
  df_fan_rb_all %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_rb_all %>% 
      select(season, player_id, rookie_year, draft_number),
    by = c("player_id", "season")
  ) %>% 
  filter(rookie_year == season) %>% 
  select(season, player_id, player_display_name, draft_number, carries) %>% 
  mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)) %>% 
  group_by(player_id, player_display_name, season, draft_number) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_rush = sum(carries)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

mod_rookie_rush_rb = 
  df_rookie_rush %>% 
  gam(
    n_rush ~ s(draft_number),
    data = .,
    method = "REML"
  )

df_rookie_rush_fin =
  df_rookie_rush %>% 
  mutate(expect_rush = predict(mod_rookie_rush_rb)) %>% 
  select(season, player_id, expect_rush)

df_fan_rb_fin_pre =
  df_fan_rb_all %>% 
  filter(between(season, 2016, 2025)) %>% 
  select(season, recent_team, position, player_id, player_display_name, target_share, carries, fpts) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id, player_display_name, position) %>% 
  mutate(
    games_missed =
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ 16 - n(),
        season >= 2021 ~ 17 - n()
      ),
    sum_fpts = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T) * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T),
        .default = NA
      ),
    mean_target_share = mean(target_share, na.rm = T),
    n_rush = sum(carries, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(season, player_id, player_display_name, position, starts_with("sum_"), starts_with("mean_"), n_rush, games_missed) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(df_ryoe_all, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_rb_epa, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_route_partic_rb, by = c("season", "player_id")) %>% 
  left_join(df_gl_att_rb, by = c("season", "player_id", "team")) %>% 
  left_join(df_rush_rate, by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_rb_all %>% 
      select(season, player_id, team, birth_date, years_exp, draft_number) %>% 
      mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)),
    by = c("season", "player_id", "team")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25,
    team = 
      case_when(
        team == "SD" ~ "LAC",
        team == "OAK" ~ "LV",
        .default = team
      )
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id, season) %>% 
  mutate(rush_share = sum(n_rush, na.rm = T) / mean(sum(n_rush_team, na.rm = T), na.rm = T)) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  drop_na(team) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      c(games_missed, mean_target_share, rush_share, n_routes, route_partic, gl_att_share, ryoe_att, mean_epa, sum_fpts),
      ~ case_when(
        row_number() == 2 ~ lag(replace_na(., 0)),
        row_number() == 3 ~ 0.65 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.35 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))),
        row_number() > 3 ~ 0.6 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.3 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))) + 0.1 * lag(lag(lag(replace_na(., 0)))),
        .default = NA
      ),
      .names = "prior_{col}"
    )
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    # prior_ays = prior_mean_air_yards_share,
    prior_tar_share = prior_mean_target_share,
    prior_fpts = prior_sum_fpts,
    prior_rb_epa = prior_mean_epa
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(df_rb_new_team, by = c("player_id", "season", "team"))

saveRDS(df_fan_rb_fin_pre, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fan_rb_fin_pre.rds"))

df_fan_rb_fin_all =
  df_fan_rb_fin_pre %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_rb_all %>% 
      left_join(df_fan_rb_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_fan_rb_fin_pre %>% 
          select(season, player_id, prior_rush_share),
        by = c("player_id", "season")
      ) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_rush_rate %>% 
          select(season, team, prior_n_rush_team),
        by = c("team", "season")
      ) %>% 
      left_join(df_rookie_rush_fin, by = c("season", "player_id")) %>% 
      mutate(
        expect_rush_rookie = sum(expect_rush, na.rm = T),
        top_20_other = sum(prior_ind_top_20, na.rm = T) - prior_ind_top_20,
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T) - prior_fpts,
        expect_rush_other = sum(prior_rush_share * prior_n_rush_team, na.rm = T) - prior_rush_share * prior_n_rush_team + expect_rush_rookie
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(player_id, season, prior_fpts_other, prior_rank, expect_rush_other),
    by = c("player_id", "season")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(df_games_missed_rb_all, by = c("player_id", "season"))# %>% 
  # filter(prior_rank <= 100 | (prior_rank > 100 & prior_games_missed > 8 & sum_fpts >= 100) | (is.na(prior_rank)))
```

```{r wr team prior}
df_gl_eff = 
  szn_all %>%
  mutate(
    goalline =
      case_when(
        yardline_100 <= 5 & two_point_attempt == 1 ~ NA,
        yardline_100 <= 5 & extra_point_attempt == 1 ~ NA,
        yardline_100 <= 5 ~ 1,
        yardline_100 > 5 ~ 0,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>%
  select(season, game_id, drive, posteam, yardline_100, goalline, touchdown, extra_point_attempt, two_point_attempt) %>%
  group_by(season, game_id, posteam, drive) %>%
  mutate(
    n_drive = row_number(),
    n_drive_gl = ifelse(goalline == 1, n_drive, NA),
    goalline_start = ifelse(n_drive_gl == min(n_drive_gl, na.rm = T), 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(season, posteam) %>%
  summarise(
    gl_trips = sum(goalline_start == 1, na.rm = T),
    gl_tds = sum(goalline == 1 & touchdown == 1, na.rm = T),
    gl_eff = gl_tds / gl_trips
  ) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(team = posteam) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      season = 2026,
      team = szn_all %>% distinct(home_team) %>% pull()
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(team, season) %>% 
  group_by(team) %>% 
  mutate(
    prior_gl_eff = lag(gl_eff),
    prior_gl_trips = lag(gl_trips)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

df_ol_cont_team = 
  df_snap_share_ol_team %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    return_ol = 
      case_when(
        team == lag(team) ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      ),
    prior_n_snaps = lag(n_snaps),
    prior_n_snaps_team = lag(n_snaps_team),
    prior_snap_share = lag(snap_share)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
      df_roster_all %>%
        filter(position %in% c("C", "T", "G", "OL")) %>%
        rename(player_id = gsis_id) %>%
        distinct(season, team, position, player_id) %>% 
        left_join(
          df_run_block_players %>% 
            mutate(
              season = season + 1
            ) %>% 
            rename(prior_grade_run = grades_run_block) %>% 
            select(season, team, player_id, prior_grade_run),
          by = c("season", "team", "player_id")
        ) %>% 
        left_join(
          df_pass_block_players %>% 
            mutate(
              season = season + 1
            ) %>% 
            rename(prior_grade_pass = grades_pass_block) %>% 
            select(season, team, player_id, prior_grade_pass),
          by = c("season", "team", "player_id")
        ),
    by = c("season", "team", "player_id")
  ) %>% 
  # drop_na(prior_n_snaps) %>% 
  group_by(season, team, return_ol) %>% 
  summarise(
    ol_cont = sum(prior_n_snaps, na.rm = T),
    ol_cont_grade_run = mean(prior_grade_run, na.rm = T),
    ol_cont_grade_pass = mean(prior_grade_pass, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(season, team) %>% 
  mutate(
    ol_cont_share = ol_cont / sum(ol_cont)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(return_ol == 1)

  # rbind(

  # ) %>% 
  # rbind(

  #     mutate(model = "knn")
  # ) %>% 
  # rbind(

  # ) %>%

  #   mod_boost_rb$pred %>% 
  #     tibble() %>% 
  #     select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
  #     mutate(model = "boost")
  # ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_svm_rb$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "svm")
  ) %>%
  group_by(model, rowIndex) %>%
  summarise(
    actual = first(obs),
    pred_oof = mean(pred)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    residual = actual - pred_oof,
    abs_residual = abs(residual),
    squared_residual = residual^2,
    # mod_var = log(squared_residual + 1),
    mod_var = abs_residual
  )
```

### Make model for rookies

```{r rb rookie}
df_fpts_rb_rookie_train =
  df_roster_rb_all %>% 
  filter(rookie_year == season) %>% 
  mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)) %>% 
  select(season, player_id, full_name, team, birth_date, draft_number) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25,
    team = 
      case_when(
        team == "SD" ~ "LAC",
        team == "OAK" ~ "LV",
        .default = team
      )
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(team) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_fan_rb_all %>% 
      select(season, position, player_id, player_display_name, fpts) %>% 
      group_by(season, player_id, player_display_name, position) %>% 
      mutate(sum_fpts = sum(fpts, na.rm = T)) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(season, player_id, sum_fpts) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = c("season", "player_id")
  ) %>% 
  # left_join(fin_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  # left_join(coach_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_rush_rate, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  group_by(season) %>%
  arrange(season, draft_number) %>% 
  slice_min(draft_number, n = 15) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(draft_number < 260) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_rb_all %>% 
      left_join(df_fan_rb_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      mutate(
        top_20_other = sum(prior_ind_top_20, na.rm = T),
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(season, team, prior_fpts_other) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = c("season", "team")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_rb_all %>% 
      left_join(df_fan_rb_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_fan_rb_fin_pre %>% 
          select(season, player_id, prior_rush_share),
        by = c("player_id", "season")
      ) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_rush_rate %>% 
          select(season, team, prior_n_rush_team),
        by = c("team", "season")
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      summarise(
        expect_rush_other = sum(prior_rush_share * prior_n_rush_team, na.rm = T)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup(),
    by = c("team", "season")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(df_ol_cont_team, by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  left_join(df_off_epa, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_gl_eff, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_def_epa_sos, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  select(player_id, sum_fpts, prior_off_rush_epa, prior_rush_rate, prior_fpts_other, player_age, draft_number, expect_rush_other, ol_cont_grade_run, prior_off_rush_epa, prior_gl_eff, def_rush_epa_sos) %>% 
  select(-c(ol_cont_grade_run, def_rush_epa_sos, prior_rush_rate, prior_gl_eff)) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  arrange(player_id) %>%
  select(-player_id)

      mutate(model = "boost")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_svm_rb_rook$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "svm")
  ) %>%
  group_by(model, rowIndex) %>%
  summarise(
    actual = first(obs),
    pred_oof = mean(pred)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    residual = actual - pred_oof,
    abs_residual = abs(residual),
    squared_residual = residual^2,
    mod_var = log(squared_residual + 1),
    mod_var = abs_residual
  )

df_mod_resid_rb_rook = 
  df_oof_pred_rb_rook %>% 
  filter(model == "svm") %>% 
  cbind(df_fpts_rb_rookie_train) %>% 
  tibble()

# test SDs:

# Calibration:
df_resid_rb_train_rook %>%
  cbind(
    df_fpts_rb_rookie_train %>%
      select(sum_fpts)
  ) %>%
  tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    mod_pred_fpts = predict(mod_boost_rb_rook, newdata = df_fpts_rb_rookie_train),
    mod_pred_resid = predict(mod_enet_rb_rook_resid, newdata = df_resid_rb_train_rook),
    # mod_pred_var = exp(mod_pred_resid) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # mod_pred_sd = sqrt(mod_pred_var),
    residual = sum_fpts - mod_pred_fpts,
    mod_pred_sd = mod_pred_resid * sqrt(pi / 2),
    # mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5)
  ) %>%
  group_by(mod_pred_sd_quant) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sd = mean(mod_pred_sd),
    resid_sd = sd(residual)
  )

# coverage:
df_resid_rb_train_rook %>%
  cbind(
    df_fpts_rb_rookie_train %>%
      select(sum_fpts)
  ) %>%
  tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    mod_pred_fpts = predict(mod_boost_rb_rook, newdata = df_fpts_rb_rookie_train),
    mod_pred_resid = predict(mod_enet_rb_rook_resid, newdata = df_resid_rb_train_rook),
    # mod_pred_var = exp(mod_pred_resid) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # mod_pred_sd = sqrt(mod_pred_var),
    residual = sum_fpts - mod_pred_fpts,
    mod_pred_sd = mod_pred_resid * sqrt(pi / 2),
    # mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    cov_1sd =
      case_when(
        abs(residual) <= mod_pred_sd ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      ),
    cov_2sd =
      case_when(
        abs(residual) <= 2 * mod_pred_sd ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      )
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cov_1sd = mean(cov_1sd),
    cov_2sd = mean(cov_2sd)
  )

      ) %>%

  left_join(df_ol_cont_team, by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  left_join(df_off_epa, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_gl_eff, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_def_epa_sos, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  select(season, full_name, player_id, sum_fpts, prior_off_rush_epa, prior_rush_rate, prior_fpts_other, player_age, draft_number, expect_rush_other, ol_cont_grade_run, prior_off_rush_epa, prior_gl_eff, def_rush_epa_sos) %>%

  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    pred_rb_rook = predict(mod_svm_rb_rook, newdata = .)
  ) %>% 
  view()
```

```{r pred test rb}
df_fpts_rb_test_pre =
  df_roster_rb_all %>% 
  filter(season %in% c(2025, 2026)) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(season %in% 2026) %>% 
  mutate(player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_fan_rb_fin_all %>% 
      filter(season %in% c(2023, 2024, 2025)) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      select(-expect_rush_other) %>% 
      drop_na(player_age) %>% 
      distinct() %>% 
      mutate(
        across(
          c(games_missed, mean_target_share, rush_share, n_routes, route_partic, gl_att_share, ryoe_att, mean_epa, sum_fpts),
          ~ case_when(
            row_number() == 1 ~ replace_na(., 0),
            row_number() == 2 ~ 0.65 * replace_na(., 0) + 0.35 * lag(replace_na(., 0)),
            row_number() == 3 ~ 0.6 * . + 0.3 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.1 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))),
            .default = NA
          ),
          .names = "prior_{col}"
        )
      ) %>% 
      select(-c(prior_rb_epa, prior_tar_share, prior_fpts)) %>% 
      rename(
        prior_tar_share = prior_mean_target_share,
        prior_fpts = prior_sum_fpts,
        prior_rb_epa = prior_mean_epa
      ) %>% 
      filter(season == 2025) %>% 
      select(player_id, player_display_name, prior_tar_share, prior_fpts, prior_rb_epa, prior_rush_share, prior_gl_att_share),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(df_rb_new_team, by = c("player_id", "season", "team"))

  df_fpts_rb_test %>% 
  mutate(
    pred_fpts_svm = predict(mod_svm_rb, newdata = df_fpts_rb_test),
    pred_resid_enet = predict(mod_enet_rb_resid, newdata = df_fpts_rb_test)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  arrange(-pred_fpts_svm) %>% 
  rowid_to_column("rb_rank_svm") %>% 
  select(rb_rank_svm, team, player_id, player_display_name, pred_fpts_svm, pred_resid_enet) %>% 
  mutate(
    # pred_var_knn = exp(pred_resid_knn) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # pred_sd_knn = sqrt(pred_var_knn),
    pred_sd_enet = pred_resid_enet * sqrt(pi / 2),
    # pred_sd_knn = sqrt(exp(pred_resid_knn) - 1)
    fpts_sim = 
      map2(
        .x = pred_fpts_svm,
        .y = pred_sd_enet,
        ~ rnorm(10000, mean = .x, sd = .y)
      )
  ) %>% 
  separate_longer_delim(fpts_sim, delim = ",") %>% 
  mutate(fpts_sim = as.double(str_remove(fpts_sim, "^c\\("))) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_sim_ind = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(player_sim_ind) %>% 
  arrange(player_sim_ind, -fpts_sim) %>% 
  mutate(
    fpts_sim_rank = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_fpts_rb_sim, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fpts_rb_sim.rds"))

  ) %>%

df_rb_project_fin =
  df_fpts_rb_sim_fin %>%
  left_join(
    df_fpts_rb_sim_fin %>% 
      distinct(player_id, pred_fpts_svm) %>% 
      rename(pred_fpts_fin = pred_fpts_svm) %>% 
      arrange(-pred_fpts_fin) %>% 
      rowid_to_column("rb_rank_fin") %>% 
      select(player_id, rb_rank_fin, pred_fpts_fin),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    top_1 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank == 1, 1, 0),
    top_5 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 5, 1, 0),
    top_12 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 12, 1, 0),
    top_24 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 24, 1, 0),
    # top_36 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 36, 1, 0),
    below_36 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank > 36, 1, 0),
    # below_50 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank > 50, 1, 0),
    pred_fpts = round(pred_fpts_svm, 1)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id, team, rb_rank_fin, player_display_name, pred_fpts) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      c(starts_with("top_"), starts_with("below_")),
      ~ sum(.) / 10000,
      .names = "prop_{col}"
    ),
    pred_rank_med = median(fpts_sim_rank),
    pred_rank_mean = mean(fpts_sim_rank),
    pred_rank_90p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.1),
    pred_rank_80p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.2),
    pred_rank_20p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.8),
    pred_rank_10p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.9)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
    df_fpts_rb_sim_fin %>% 
      group_by(player_id, team, player_display_name) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, team, player_display_name, fpts_sim) %>% 
      mutate(
        fpts_sim_quant = ntile(fpts_sim, n = 20),
        fpts_sim_quant_rank = row_number()
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      filter(fpts_sim_quant_rank %in% c(1000, 2000, 5000, 8000, 9000)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = fpts_sim_quant_rank,
        names_prefix = "quant_",
        values_from = fpts_sim
      ) %>% 
      rename(
        pred_fpts_med = quant_5000,
        pred_fpts_90p = quant_9000,
        pred_fpts_80p = quant_8000,
        pred_fpts_20p = quant_2000,
        pred_fpts_10p = quant_1000
      ) %>% 
      mutate(across(starts_with("pred_"), ~ round(ifelse(. < 0, 0, .), 1))) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      fill(starts_with("pred_"), .direction = "downup") %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(player_id, pred_fpts_med, starts_with("pred_fpts_") & ends_with("p")) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  # select(-player_id) %>% 
  relocate(pred_fpts_med, starts_with("pred_fpts_") & ends_with("p"), .after = pred_fpts)

set.seed(37564)
boot_splits = bootstraps(fpts_rb_train_df, times = 100)

# 2. Predict for each bootstrap model
boot_preds = map(boot_splits$splits, ~ {
  train_data = analysis(.x)
  
  # Train SVM model
  svm_model = train(
    sum_fpts ~ ., 
    data = train_data,
    method = "svmRadial",
    trControl = trainControl(method = "none"),  # already tuned
    tuneGrid = tibble(
      sigma = mod_svm_rb$bestTune[[1]],
      C = mod_svm_rb$bestTune[[2]]
    )
  )
  
  # Predict on the fixed test set
  predict(svm_model, newdata = fpts_rb_test_df)
})

# 3. Combine predictions into a matrix
pred_matrix = do.call(cbind, boot_preds)

# 4. Compute mean prediction and 95% prediction interval
rb_boot_pred_bands = 
  fpts_rb_test_df %>%
  select(player_id, full_name) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_mean  = round(rowMeans(pred_matrix), 2), 
    pred_lower = round(apply(pred_matrix, 1, quantile, probs = 0.1), 2),
    pred_upper = round(apply(pred_matrix, 1, quantile, probs = 0.9), 2),
  )

view(rb_boot_pred_bands)

set.seed(37564)
boot_splits_rook = bootstraps(fpts_rb_rookie_train_df, times = 100)

# Fit model to each resample and generate predictions
boot_preds_rook = 
  boot_splits_rook %>%
  mutate(
    preds = 
      map(
        splits, 
        ~ {
          model = earth(sum_fpts ~ ., data = analysis(.x), nprune = mod_mars_rb_rook$bestTune[[1]], degree = mod_mars_rb_rook$bestTune[[2]])
    predict(model, fpts_rb_rookie_test_df)
      }
    )
  )

# Convert predictions into long-format tibble
rb_boot_pred_bands_rook = 
  boot_preds_rook %>%
  select(preds) %>%
  unnest_longer(preds, indices_to = "player_index") %>%
  group_by(player_index) %>%
  summarise(
    pred_mean = mean(preds),
    pred_lower = quantile(preds, 0.10),
    pred_upper = quantile(preds, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    full_name = fpts_rb_rookie_test_df$full_name[player_index],
    player_id = fpts_rb_rookie_test_df$player_id[player_index],
    across(c(pred_mean, pred_lower, pred_upper), ~ round(., 2))
  ) %>%
  select(player_id, full_name, pred_mean, pred_lower, pred_upper)

view(rb_boot_pred_bands_rook)

  left_join(
    teams_colors_logos %>% 
      rename(team = team_abbr) %>% 
      select(team, team_color), 
    by = "team"
  ) %>% 
  filter(rb_rank <= 50) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(full_name, pred_fpts_fin_mod), x = pred_fpts_fin_mod)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = pred_lower, xmax = pred_upper, color = team_color), height = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = team_color), size = 2.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = full_name, x = pred_upper + 1, color = team_color), hjust = 0, size = 3.15)+
  scale_color_identity() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 300, by = 25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted Fantasy Points (0.5 PPR)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "RB Fantasy Point Predictions with 80% Confidence Bands"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off",
    xlim = c(50, 280)
  )

fpts_rb_2025_fin_rank_export = 
  fpts_rb_2025_fin_rank %>% 
  select(rb_rank, team, full_name, pred_fpts_fin_mod, pred_lower, pred_upper, cohort)# %>% 
  # mutate(
  #   pt_diff = pred_fpts_fin_mod - lag(pred_fpts_fin_mod),
  #   tier_init = ifelse(is.na(pt_diff) | pt_diff < -5, 1, 0)
  # )

write.csv(fpts_rb_2025_fin_rank_export, glue::glue("fpts_rb_2025_fin_rank_{format(Sys.Date(), '%Y_%m_%d')}.csv"), row.names = F)
```

```{r get data}
df_fan_te_season_finish = 
  df_fan_te_all %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    fpts_total = sum(fpts)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    fpts_total = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ fpts_total * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ fpts_total,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season) %>% 
  arrange(season, desc(fpts_total)) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    season_rank = row_number(),
    season_finish = 
      factor(
        case_when(
          between(season_rank, 1, 20) ~ "Top 20",
          between(season_rank, 21, 50) ~ "21 - 50",
          season_rank > 50 ~ "Over 50",
          .default = NA
        ),
        levels = c("Top 20", "21 - 50", "Over 50")
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()
  
saveRDS(df_fan_te_season_finish, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fan_te_season_finish.rds"))

df_route_partic_te =
  df_participation_te %>% 
  left_join(
    szn_all %>% 
      select(season, posteam, game_id, play_id, pass),
    by = c("game_id", "play_id")
  ) %>% 
  filter(pass == 1) %>% 
  rename(team = posteam) %>% 
  group_by(season, team, player_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_routes = n()
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    n_routes = 
      case_when(
        n() > 1 ~ sum(n_routes, na.rm = T),
        n() == 1 ~ n_routes,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    n_routes = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ n_routes * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ n_routes,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(df_pass_rate %>% select(season, team, n_pass), by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  mutate(
    route_partic = n_routes / n_pass
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  mutate(route_partic = mean(route_partic, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup()

df_te_usage = 
  df_participation %>% 
  filter(!is.na(offense_players) & offense_players != "") %>% 
  mutate(
    ind_te_field = 
      case_when(
        str_detect(offense_personnel, "[1-9] TE") ~ 1, 
        .default = 0
      )
  ) %>% 
  rename(game_id = nflverse_game_id) %>% 
  left_join(
    szn_all %>% 
      select(game_id, play_id, week, season, posteam),
    by = c("game_id", "play_id")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(posteam, season) %>% 
  drop_na(season, posteam, ind_te_field) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_plays = n(),
    n_te_field = sum(ind_te_field, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  rename(team = posteam) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      season = 2026,
      team = szn_all %>% distinct(home_team) %>% pull()
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(team, season) %>% 
  mutate(
    prop_te_use = n_te_field / n_plays,
    prior_te_use = lag(prop_te_use)
  )

df_fan_te_fin_pre =
  df_fan_te_all %>% 
  filter(between(season, 2016, 2025)) %>% 
  select(season, recent_team, position, player_id, player_display_name, receptions, receiving_yards, receiving_air_yards, racr, air_yards_share, target_share, fpts) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id, player_display_name, position) %>% 
  mutate(
    games_missed = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ 16 - n(),
        season >= 2021 ~ 17 - n()
      ),
    sum_yards = sum(receiving_yards, na.rm = T),
    sum_rec = sum(receptions, na.rm = T),
    sum_fpts = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T) * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T),
        .default = NA
      ),
    mean_racr = mean(racr, na.rm = T),
    mean_air_yards_share = mean(air_yards_share, na.rm = T),
    mean_target_share = mean(target_share, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(season, player_id, player_display_name, position, starts_with("sum_"), starts_with("mean_"), games_missed) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(df_route_partic_te, by = c("season", "player_id")) %>% 
  left_join(df_rz_tar_wr, by = c("season", "player_id", "team")) %>% 
  mutate(
    yprr = sum_yards / n_routes
  ) %>% 
  # group_by(season) %>% 
  # mutate(season_rank = rank(desc(sum_fpts))) %>% 
  # ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_te_all %>% 
      select(season, player_id, team, birth_date, years_exp, draft_number) %>% 
      mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)),
    by = c("season", "player_id", "team")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25,
    team = 
      case_when(
        team == "SD" ~ "LAC",
        team == "OAK" ~ "LV",
        .default = team
      )
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id, season) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  drop_na(team) %>% 
  left_join(df_qb_epa_teams, by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    # across(
    #   c(games_missed, mean_air_yards_share, mean_target_share, sum_fpts),
    #   ~ lag(.),
    #   .names = "prior_{col}"
    # ),
    across(
      c(games_missed, mean_air_yards_share, mean_target_share, n_routes, route_partic, yprr, rz_tar_share, sum_fpts),
      ~ case_when(
        row_number() == 2 ~ lag(replace_na(., 0)),
        row_number() == 3 ~ 0.65 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.35 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))),
        row_number() > 3 ~ 0.6 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.3 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))) + 0.1 * lag(lag(lag(replace_na(., 0)))),
        .default = NA
      ),
      .names = "prior_{col}"
    )#,
    # wr_new_team = 
    #   case_when(
    #     lag(team) != team ~ 1,
    #     .default = 0
    #   ),
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    prior_ays = prior_mean_air_yards_share,
    prior_tar_share = prior_mean_target_share,
    prior_fpts = prior_sum_fpts
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_te_new_team, by = c("season", "team", "player_id")) %>% 
  mutate(
    new_qb_new_team = 
      # as.factor(
        case_when(
          qb_new_team == 1 | te_new_team == 1 ~ 1,
          .default = 0
        )
      # )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_fan_te_fin_pre, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fan_te_fin_pre.rds"))

df_fan_te_fin_all = 
  df_fan_te_fin_pre %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_te_all %>% 
      left_join(df_fan_te_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_fan_te_fin_pre %>% 
          select(season, player_id, prior_tar_share),
        by = c("player_id", "season")
      ) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_qb_epa_teams %>% 
          select(season, team, prior_n_pass),
        by = c("team", "season")
      ) %>% 
      rbind(
        df_roster_wr_all %>% 
          left_join(df_fan_wr_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
          select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
          mutate(
            ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
          ) %>% 
          group_by(player_id) %>% 
          arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
          mutate(
            prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
            prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
            prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
          ) %>% 
          ungroup() %>% 
          group_by(season, team) %>% 
          arrange(season, team) %>% 
          filter(season != 2016) %>% 
          left_join(
            df_fan_wr_fin_pre %>% 
              select(season, player_id, prior_tar_share),
            by = c("player_id", "season")
          ) %>% 
          left_join(
            df_qb_epa_teams %>% 
              select(season, team, prior_n_pass),
            by = c("team", "season")
          )
      ) %>% 
      left_join(df_rookie_tar_fin, by = c("season", "player_id")) %>% 
      mutate(
        expect_tar_rookie = sum(expect_tar, na.rm = T),
        top_20_other = sum(prior_ind_top_20, na.rm = T) - prior_ind_top_20,
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T) - prior_fpts,
        expect_tar_other = sum(prior_tar_share * prior_n_pass, na.rm = T) - prior_tar_share * prior_n_pass + expect_tar_rookie
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(player_id, season, prior_fpts_other, prior_rank, expect_tar_other),
    by = c("player_id", "season")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(df_games_missed_te_all, by = c("player_id", "season"))# %>% 
  # filter(prior_rank <= 100 | (prior_rank > 100 & prior_games_missed > 8 & sum_fpts >= 100) | (is.na(prior_rank)))

saveRDS(df_fan_te_fin_all, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fan_te_fin_all.rds"))

view(df_fan_te_fin_all)
```

### Train models

```{r wr team prior}
# load("mod_df_as_of_2023.Rdata")
# load("coach_df_as_of_2025.Rdata")

df_fan_te_fin_all = readRDS(str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fan_te_fin_all.rds"))
df_te_usage = readRDS(str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_te_usage.rds"))
df_te_new_team = readRDS(str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_te_new_team.rds"))
df_games_missed_te_all = readRDS(str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_games_missed_te_all.rds"))

df_fpts_te_train = 
  df_fan_te_fin_all %>% 
  filter(prior_rank <= 40 | (is.na(prior_rank)) | prior_fpts >= 85) %>% 
  left_join(df_off_epa, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_te_usage, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_rz_eff, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_def_epa_sos, by = c("team", "season")) %>%
  # left_join(coach_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  # left_join(mod_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  select(player_id, sum_fpts, prior_ays, prior_tar_share, prior_fpts, prior_qb_epa, prior_n_pass, prior_off_pass_epa, def_pass_epa_sos, prior_rz_eff, prior_rz_trips, prior_n_routes, prior_route_partic, prior_yprr, prior_rz_tar_share, player_age, draft_number, prior_te_use, prior_fpts_other, expect_tar_other, new_qb_new_team, prior_games_missed, games_missed_rate) %>% 
  mutate(
    expect_tar = prior_tar_share * prior_n_pass,
    expect_ay = prior_ays * prior_n_pass,
    expect_routes = prior_route_partic * prior_n_pass,
    expect_rz_opp = prior_rz_tar_share * prior_rz_trips
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(prior_games_missed, prior_rz_trips, prior_n_pass, prior_rz_eff, prior_fpts_other, prior_rz_tar_share, prior_n_routes, prior_route_partic, expect_ay, prior_tar_share, prior_qb_epa, prior_te_use, new_qb_new_team, expect_rz_opp, def_pass_epa_sos, expect_routes)) %>%
  # select(-any_of(df_feature_svm %>% filter(delta_rmse < -0.06) %>% pull(var_svm))) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  arrange(player_id) %>% 
  select(-player_id) %>% 
  relocate(sum_fpts, .after = last_col())

saveRDS(df_fpts_te_train, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fpts_te_train.rds"))

view(df_fpts_te_train)

cor(df_fpts_te_train)

df_oof_pred_te = 
  mod_glm_te$pred %>% 
  tibble() %>% 
  select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
  mutate(model = "glm") %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_enet_te$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "enet")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_knn_te$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "knn")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_mars_te$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "mars")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_boost_te$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "boost")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_svm_te$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "svm")
  ) %>%
  group_by(model, rowIndex) %>%
  summarise(
    actual = first(obs),
    pred_oof = mean(pred)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    residual = actual - pred_oof,
    abs_residual = abs(residual),
    squared_residual = residual^2,
    # mod_var = log(squared_residual + 1),
    mod_var = abs_residual
  )

# test SDs:

# Calibration:
df_resid_te_train %>%
  cbind(
    df_fpts_te_train %>%
      select(sum_fpts)
  ) %>%
  tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    mod_pred_fpts = predict(mod_boost_te, newdata = df_fpts_te_train),
    mod_pred_resid = predict(mod_knn_te_resid, newdata = df_resid_te_train),
    # mod_pred_var = exp(mod_pred_resid) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # mod_pred_sd = sqrt(mod_pred_var),
    residual = sum_fpts - mod_pred_fpts,
    mod_pred_sd = mod_pred_resid,
    # mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(mod_pred_sd_quant) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sd = mean(mod_pred_sd),
    resid_sd = sd(residual)
  )

# coverage:
df_resid_te_train %>%
  cbind(
    df_fpts_te_train %>%
      select(sum_fpts)
  ) %>%
  tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    mod_pred_fpts = predict(mod_boost_te, newdata = df_fpts_te_train),
    mod_pred_resid = predict(mod_knn_te_resid, newdata = df_resid_te_train),
    # mod_pred_var = exp(mod_pred_resid) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # mod_pred_sd = sqrt(mod_pred_var),
    residual = sum_fpts - mod_pred_fpts,
    mod_pred_sd = mod_pred_resid,
    # mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    cov_1sd =
      case_when(
        abs(residual) <= mod_pred_sd ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      ),
    cov_2sd =
      case_when(
        abs(residual) <= 2 * mod_pred_sd ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      )
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cov_1sd = mean(cov_1sd),
    cov_2sd = mean(cov_2sd)
  )
```

```{r wr rookie}
fpts_te_rookie_train_df =
  roster_te_all %>% 
  filter(rookie_year == season) %>% 
  select(season, player_id, full_name, team, birth_date, draft_number) %>% 
  mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25,
    team = 
      case_when(
        team == "SD" ~ "LAC",
        team == "OAK" ~ "LV",
        .default = team
      )
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(team) %>% 
  left_join(qb_epa_teams_df, by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  left_join(
    fan_te_all %>% 
      select(season, position, player_id, player_display_name, fpts) %>% 
      group_by(season, player_id, player_display_name, position) %>% 
      mutate(
        sum_fpts = 
          case_when(
            season < 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T) * 17 / 16,
            season >= 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T),
            .default = NA
          )
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(season, player_id, sum_fpts) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = c("season", "player_id")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    roster_te_all %>% 
      left_join(fan_te_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(season, team, prior_fpts_other) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = c("season", "team")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(fin_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(coach_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  group_by(season) %>%
  arrange(season, draft_number) %>% 
  slice_min(draft_number, n = 10) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(player_id, sum_fpts, prior_qb_epa, prior_n_pass, prior_off_pass_epa, prior_fpts_other, player_age, draft_number, coach_exp_off) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  arrange(player_id) %>%
  select(-player_id)

view(fpts_te_rookie_train_df)

ctrl = trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 5, repeats = 10)

# Lasso

mod_lass_te_rook = train(sum_fpts ~ .,
                 na.action = na.exclude, 
                 data = fpts_te_rookie_train_df,

# KNN

                preProcess = c("center","scale"),
                tuneGrid = data.frame(k = seq(20, 40, by = 2)),

ggplot(mod_knn_te_rook, highlight = T) +

# MARS
set.seed(37564)
mod_mars_te_rook = train(sum_fpts ~ .,
                 na.action = na.exclude,

                 tuneGrid = expand.grid(degree = 1:3, nprune = 1:10), 
                 trControl = ctrl)

# Boost
set.seed(37564)
mod_boost_te_rook = train(sum_fpts ~ .,
                  na.action = na.exclude, 
                  data = fpts_te_rookie_train_df, 
                  method = "gbm", 
                  tuneGrid = expand.grid(n.trees = c(5000, 7000, 9000),
                                         interaction.depth = 1,
                                         shrinkage = c(0.0003, 0.0005, 0.0007), 
                                         n.minobsinnode = 1), 
                  trControl = ctrl,
                  verbose = F)
ggplot(mod_boost_te_rook, highlight = T) + 
  ggtitle("Boost") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

mod_svm_te_rook = train(sum_fpts ~ .,
                na.action = na.exclude, 
                data = fpts_te_rookie_train_df,
                preProcess = c("scale", "center"),
                method = "svmRadialSigma",
                tuneGrid = expand.grid(C = exp(seq(-4, -2, len = 5)),
                                       sigma = exp(seq(-5,-1, len = 5))),
                trControl = ctrl)
ggplot(mod_svm_te_rook, highlight = T) +

vip(

  train = fpts_te_rookie_train_df,
  target = "sum_fpts",

)

coef(mod_lass_te_rook$finalModel, mod_lass_te_rook$bestTune$lambda)

# Resamples
set.seed(37564)
res = resamples(list(GLM = mod_glm_te_rook, LASSO = mod_lass_te_rook, MARS = mod_mars_te_rook, KNN = mod_knn_te_rook, BOOST = mod_boost_te_rook, SVM = mod_svm_te_rook))
summary(res)
bwplot(res, metric = "RMSE", main = "RMSE for Repeated 5-Fold CV Using Various Models")
```

```{r pred test}
set.seed(37564)
df_fpts_te_sim =
  df_fpts_te_test %>% 
  mutate(
    pred_fpts_boost = predict(mod_boost_te, newdata = df_fpts_te_test),
    pred_resid_knn = predict(mod_knn_te_resid, newdata = df_fpts_te_test)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  arrange(-pred_fpts_boost) %>% 
  rowid_to_column("te_rank_boost") %>% 
  select(te_rank_boost, team, player_id, player_display_name, pred_fpts_boost, pred_resid_knn) %>% 
  mutate(
    # pred_var_knn = exp(pred_resid_knn) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # pred_sd_knn = sqrt(pred_var_knn),
    pred_sd_knn = pred_resid_knn,
    # pred_sd_knn = sqrt(exp(pred_resid_knn) - 1)
    fpts_sim = 
      map2(
        .x = pred_fpts_boost,
        .y = pred_sd_knn,
        ~ rnorm(10000, mean = .x, sd = .y)
      )
  ) %>% 
  separate_longer_delim(fpts_sim, delim = ",") %>% 
  mutate(fpts_sim = as.double(str_remove(fpts_sim, "^c\\("))) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_sim_ind = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(player_sim_ind) %>% 
  arrange(player_sim_ind, -fpts_sim) %>% 
  mutate(
    fpts_sim_rank = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_fpts_te_sim, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fpts_te_sim.rds"))

df_te_project_fin =
  df_fpts_te_sim %>% 
  mutate(
    top_1 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank == 1, 1, 0),
    top_5 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 5, 1, 0),
    top_12 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 12, 1, 0),
    top_24 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 24, 1, 0),
    # top_36 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 36, 1, 0),
    below_24 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank > 24, 1, 0),
    below_36 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank > 36, 1, 0),
    # below_50 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank > 50, 1, 0),
    pred_fpts = round(pred_fpts_boost, 1)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id, team, te_rank_boost, player_display_name, pred_fpts) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      c(starts_with("top_"), starts_with("below_")),
      ~ sum(.) / 10000,
      .names = "prop_{col}"
    ),
    pred_rank_med = median(fpts_sim_rank),
    pred_rank_mean = mean(fpts_sim_rank),
    pred_rank_90p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.1),
    pred_rank_80p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.2),
    pred_rank_20p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.8),
    pred_rank_10p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.9)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
    df_fpts_te_sim %>% 
      group_by(player_id, team, player_display_name) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, team, player_display_name, fpts_sim) %>% 
      mutate(
        fpts_sim_quant = ntile(fpts_sim, n = 20),
        fpts_sim_quant_rank = row_number()
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      filter(fpts_sim_quant_rank %in% c(1000, 2000, 5000, 8000, 9000)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = fpts_sim_quant_rank,
        names_prefix = "quant_",
        values_from = fpts_sim
      ) %>% 
      rename(
        pred_fpts_med = quant_5000,
        pred_fpts_90p = quant_9000,
        pred_fpts_80p = quant_8000,
        pred_fpts_20p = quant_2000,
        pred_fpts_10p = quant_1000
      ) %>% 
      mutate(across(starts_with("pred_"), ~ round(ifelse(. < 0, 0, .), 1))) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      fill(starts_with("pred_"), .direction = "downup") %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(player_id, pred_fpts_med, starts_with("pred_fpts_") & ends_with("p")) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  # select(-player_id) %>% 
  relocate(pred_fpts_med, starts_with("pred_fpts_") & ends_with("p"), .after = pred_fpts)

df_fpts_te_sim %>% 
  group_by(player_id, team, player_display_name) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, team, player_display_name, fpts_sim) %>% 
  mutate(
    fpts_sim_quant = ntile(fpts_sim, n = 20),
    fpts_sim_quant_rank = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(fpts_sim_quant_rank %in% c(2000, 5000, 8000)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = fpts_sim_quant_rank,
    names_prefix = "quant_",
    values_from = fpts_sim
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    pred_med = quant_5000,
    pred_upper = quant_8000,
    pred_lower = quant_2000
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  fill(starts_with("pred_"), .direction = "downup") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-player_sim_ind) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(
    player_display_name = str_c(te_rank_boost, ". ", player_display_name)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    teams_colors_logos %>% 
      rename(team = team_abbr) %>% 
      select(team, team_color), 
    by = "team"
  ) %>% 
  filter(te_rank_boost <= 20) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(player_display_name, -te_rank_boost), x = pred_med)) + 
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = pred_lower, xmax = pred_upper, color = team_color), height = 1) +
  # geom_boxplot(aes(color = team_color), size = 0.85) +
  geom_point(aes(color = team_color), size = 2.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = player_display_name, x = pred_upper + 1, color = team_color), hjust = 0, size = 3.15)+
  scale_color_identity() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 450, by = 25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted Fantasy Points (PPR)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "TE Fantasy Point Predictions"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off",
    xlim = c(75, 325)
  )



fpts_te_test_df =
  roster_te_all %>% 
  filter(season %in% c(2024, 2025)) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    te_new_team = 
      case_when(
        lag(team) != team ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      ),
    draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(season %in% 2025) %>% 
  mutate(player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25) %>% 
  left_join(
    fan_te_fin_all %>% 
      filter(season == 2024) %>% 
      select(player_id, mean_air_yards_share, mean_target_share, sum_fpts, games_missed) %>% 
      rename(
        prior_games_missed = games_missed,
        prior_ays = mean_air_yards_share,
        prior_tar_share = mean_target_share,
        prior_fpts = sum_fpts
      ),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    fin_df %>% 
    # mod_df %>% 
      filter(season == 2024) %>% 
      select(team, off_pass_epa) %>% 
      rename(prior_off_pass_epa = off_pass_epa),
    by = "team"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    qb_epa_teams_df %>% 
      filter(season == 2025) %>% 
      select(team, prior_qb_epa, qb_new_team, prior_n_pass),
    by = "team"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    roster_te_all %>% 
      left_join(fan_te_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      mutate(
        top_20_other = sum(prior_ind_top_20, na.rm = T) - prior_ind_top_20,
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T) - prior_fpts
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, prior_fpts_other, prior_rank) %>% 
      filter(season == 2025),
    by = c("season", "player_id", "team")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    coach_df %>% 
      filter(season == 2025) %>% 
      select(season, team, coach_exp_off),
    by = c("season", "team")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    new_qb_new_team = 
      case_when(
        qb_new_team == 1 | te_new_team == 1 ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      )
  ) %>% 
  # filter(prior_rank <= 100 | (prior_rank > 100 & prior_games_missed > 8 | (is.na(prior_rank)))) %>% 
  left_join(games_missed_te_all, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(te_rz_rate_df, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  filter(prior_rank <= 40 | is.na(prior_rank)) %>% 
  select(player_id, full_name, team, prior_ays, prior_tar_share, games_missed_rate, prior_fpts, prior_qb_epa, prior_n_pass, prior_off_pass_epa, prior_rz_rate, player_age, draft_number, prior_fpts_other, coach_exp_off, new_qb_new_team) %>% 
  select(-c(prior_n_pass, new_qb_new_team, coach_exp_off)) %>%
  drop_na()

view(fpts_te_test_df)

fpts_te_rookie_test_df = 
  roster_te_all %>% 
  filter(rookie_year == 2025) %>% 
  mutate(player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25) %>% 
  mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)) %>% 
  left_join(
    fin_df %>% 
    # mod_df %>% 
      filter(season == 2024) %>% 
      select(team, off_pass_epa) %>% 
      rename(prior_off_pass_epa = off_pass_epa),
    by = "team"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    qb_epa_teams_df %>% 
      filter(season == 2025) %>% 
      select(team, prior_qb_epa, prior_n_pass),
    by = "team"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    roster_te_all %>% 
      left_join(fan_te_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(season, team, prior_fpts_other) %>% 
      distinct() %>% 
      filter(season == 2025),
    by = c("season", "team")
  ) %>% 
  # left_join(mod_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(coach_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  group_by(season) %>% 
  arrange(season, draft_number) %>% 
  slice_min(draft_number, n = 15) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(player_id, full_name, team, prior_qb_epa, prior_n_pass, prior_off_pass_epa, prior_fpts_other, player_age, draft_number, coach_exp_off) %>% 
  drop_na()

view(fpts_te_rookie_test_df)

fpts_te_2025 = 
  fpts_te_test_df %>% 
  mutate(
    pred_fpts_mars = predict(mod_mars_te, newdata = fpts_te_test_df)[, 1],
    pred_fpts_boost = predict(mod_boost_te, newdata = fpts_te_test_df),
    # pred_fpts_glm = predict(mod_glm_wr, newdata = fpts_wr_test_df),
    # pred_fpts_lass = predict(mod_lass_wr, newdata = fpts_wr_test_df),
    pred_fpts_svm = predict(mod_svm_te, newdata = fpts_te_test_df),
    # pred_fpts_knn = predict(mod_knn_wr, newdata = fpts_wr_test_df)
  ) %>% 
  select(team, player_id, full_name, pred_fpts_boost, pred_fpts_mars, pred_fpts_svm) %>% 
  mutate(
    cohort = "Non-Rookie"
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    fpts_te_rookie_test_df %>%
      mutate(
        pred_fpts_mars = predict(mod_mars_te_rook, newdata = fpts_te_rookie_test_df)[, 1],
        pred_fpts_boost = predict(mod_boost_te_rook, newdata = fpts_te_rookie_test_df),
        pred_fpts_svm = predict(mod_svm_te_rook, newdata = fpts_te_rookie_test_df)
      ) %>%
      select(team, player_id, full_name, pred_fpts_boost, pred_fpts_mars, pred_fpts_svm) %>%
      mutate(
        cohort = "Rookie"
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_fpts_mars = round(pred_fpts_mars, 2),
    pred_fpts_boost = round(pred_fpts_boost, 2),
    pred_fpts_svm = round(pred_fpts_svm, 2),
    pred_fpts_fin_mod = 
      case_when(
        cohort == "Rookie" ~ pred_fpts_mars,
        cohort == "Non-Rookie" ~ pred_fpts_svm,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(-pred_fpts_fin_mod) %>% 
  rowid_to_column("te_rank")

view(fpts_te_2025)

set.seed(37564)
boot_splits = bootstraps(fpts_te_train_df, times = 100)

# 2. Predict for each bootstrap model
boot_preds = map(boot_splits$splits, ~ {
  train_data = analysis(.x)
  
  # Train SVM model
  svm_model = train(
    sum_fpts ~ ., 
    data = train_data,
    method = "svmRadial",
    trControl = trainControl(method = "none"),  # already tuned
    tuneGrid = tibble(
      sigma = mod_svm_te$bestTune[[1]],
      C = mod_svm_te$bestTune[[2]]
    )
  )
  
  # Predict on the fixed test set
  predict(svm_model, newdata = fpts_te_test_df)
})

# 3. Combine predictions into a matrix
pred_matrix = do.call(cbind, boot_preds)

# 4. Compute mean prediction and 95% prediction interval
te_boot_pred_bands = 
  fpts_te_test_df %>%
  select(player_id, full_name) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_mean  = round(rowMeans(pred_matrix), 2), 
    pred_lower = round(apply(pred_matrix, 1, quantile, probs = 0.1), 2),
    pred_upper = round(apply(pred_matrix, 1, quantile, probs = 0.9), 2),
  )

view(te_boot_pred_bands)

set.seed(37564)
boot_splits_rook = bootstraps(fpts_te_rookie_train_df, times = 100)

# Fit model to each resample and generate predictions
boot_preds_rook = 
  boot_splits_rook %>%
  mutate(
    preds = 
      map(
        splits, 
        ~ {
          model = earth(sum_fpts ~ ., data = analysis(.x), nprune = mod_mars_te_rook$bestTune[[1]], degree = mod_mars_te_rook$bestTune[[2]])
    predict(model, fpts_te_rookie_test_df)
      }
    )
  )

# Convert predictions into long-format tibble
te_boot_pred_bands_rook = 
  boot_preds_rook %>%
  select(preds) %>%
  unnest_longer(preds, indices_to = "player_index") %>%
  group_by(player_index) %>%
  summarise(
    pred_mean = mean(preds),
    pred_lower = quantile(preds, 0.10),
    pred_upper = quantile(preds, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    full_name = fpts_te_rookie_test_df$full_name[player_index],
    player_id = fpts_te_rookie_test_df$player_id[player_index],
    across(c(pred_mean, pred_lower, pred_upper), ~ round(., 2))
  ) %>%
  select(player_id, full_name, pred_mean, pred_lower, pred_upper)

view(te_boot_pred_bands_rook)

fpts_te_2025_fin_rank = 
  fpts_te_2025 %>% 
  left_join(
    te_boot_pred_bands %>% 
      rbind(te_boot_pred_bands_rook), 
    by = c("player_id", "full_name")
  )

view(fpts_te_2025_fin_rank)

fpts_te_2025_fin_rank %>% 
  left_join(
    teams_colors_logos %>% 
      rename(team = team_abbr) %>% 
      select(team, team_color), 
    by = "team"
  ) %>% 
  filter(te_rank <= 20) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(full_name, pred_fpts_fin_mod), x = pred_fpts_fin_mod)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = pred_lower, xmax = pred_upper, color = team_color), height = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = team_color), size = 2.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = full_name, x = pred_upper + 1, color = team_color), hjust = 0, size = 3.15)+
  scale_color_identity() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 300, by = 25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted Fantasy Points (0.5 PPR)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "TE Fantasy Point Predictions with 80% Confidence Bands"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off",
    xlim = c(60, 200)
  )

# exporting rankings:

fpts_te_2025_fin_rank_export = 
  fpts_te_2025_fin_rank %>% 
  select(te_rank, team, full_name, pred_fpts_fin_mod, pred_lower, pred_upper, cohort)

write.csv(fpts_te_2025_fin_rank_export, glue::glue("fpts_te_2025_fin_rank_{format(Sys.Date(), '%Y_%m_%d')}.csv"), row.names = F)
```

```{r get data}
  calculate_player_stats() %>% 
  filter(position == "QB") %>% 
  select(player_id, player_display_name, games) %>% 
  left_join(
    roster_all_df %>% 
      filter(position == "QB") %>% 
      rename(player_id = gsis_id) %>% 
      select(player_id, full_name, entry_year) %>% 
      distinct(),

df_fan_qb_season_finish = 
  df_fan_qb_all %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    fpts_total = sum(fpts)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    fpts_total = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ fpts_total * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ fpts_total,
        .default = NA
      )
  ) %>% 
  group_by(season) %>% 
  arrange(season, desc(fpts_total)) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    season_rank = row_number(),
    season_finish = 
      factor(
        case_when(
          between(season_rank, 1, 20) ~ "Top 20",
          between(season_rank, 21, 50) ~ "21 - 50",
          season_rank > 50 ~ "Over 50",
          .default = NA
        ),
        levels = c("Top 20", "21 - 50", "Over 50")
      )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()
  
saveRDS(df_fan_qb_season_finish, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fan_qb_season_finish.rds"))

df_qb_gl_rate = 
  df_roster_qb_all %>% 
    left_join(
      szn_all %>% 
        filter(between(season, 2016, 2025)) %>% 
        filter(rush == 1 & yardline_100 <= 5 & !is.na(rusher_player_id)) %>% 
        rename(player_id = rusher_player_id) %>% 
        group_by(player_id, season) %>% 
        summarise(
          n_gl_att = n()
        ) %>% 
        ungroup(),
      by = c("player_id", "season")
    ) %>% 
    left_join(
      szn_all %>% 
        filter(between(season, 2016, 2025)) %>% 
        filter(rush == 1 & yardline_100 <= 5 & !is.na(rusher_player_id)) %>% 
        rename(team = posteam) %>% 
        group_by(team, season) %>% 
        summarise(
          n_gl_att_team = n()
        ) %>% 
        ungroup(),
      by = c("season", "team")
    ) %>% 
    arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
    group_by(player_id) %>% 
    mutate(
      gl_rate = n_gl_att / n_gl_att_team,
      prior_gl_rate = lag(gl_rate)
    ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(season, team, player_id, prior_gl_rate) %>% 
    mutate(
      team = 
        case_when(
          team == "SD" ~ "LAC",
          team == "OAK" ~ "LV",
          .default = team
        )
    )

saveRDS(df_qb_gl_rate, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_qb_gl_rate.rds"))

view(df_qb_gl_rate)

df_qb_rush_att =
  df_roster_qb_all %>% 
  left_join(
    szn_all %>% 
      filter(between(season, 2016, 2026)) %>% 
      select(season, posteam, play_type, rusher_player_id) %>% 
      filter(play_type %in% c("run")) %>%
      rename(
        team = posteam,
        player_id = rusher_player_id
      ) %>% 
      group_by(season, player_id) %>% 
      summarise(
        n_rush = n()
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      mutate(
        n_rush = 
          case_when(
            season < 2021 ~ n_rush * 17 / 16,
            season >= 2021 ~ n_rush,
            .default = NA
          )
      ),
    by = c("player_id", "season")
  ) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    # prior_pass_rate = lag(pass_rate),
    prior_n_rush = lag(n_rush)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(player_id, season, prior_n_rush)

df_fan_qb_fin_pre =
  df_fan_qb_all %>% 
  filter(between(season, 2016, 2025)) %>% 
  select(season, recent_team, position, player_id, player_display_name, carries, attempts, fpts) %>% 
  group_by(season, player_id, player_display_name, position) %>% 
  mutate(
    games_missed =
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ 16 - n(),
        season >= 2021 ~ 17 - n()
      ),
    sum_fpts = 
      case_when(
        season < 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T) * 17 / 16,
        season >= 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T),
        .default = NA
      ),
    fpts_game = sum_fpts / n(),
    n_rush = sum(carries, na.rm = T),
    n_pass = sum(attempts, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(season, player_id, player_display_name, position, starts_with("sum_"), fpts_game, n_rush, n_pass, games_missed) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(df_qb_epa, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_qb_cpoe, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  mutate(
    team = 
      case_when(
        posteam == "SD" ~ "LAC",
        posteam == "OAK" ~ "LV",
        .default = posteam
      )
  ) %>% 
  left_join(df_qb_adot, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  # left_join(df_qb_gl_rate, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_gl_att_rb, by = c("season", "player_id", "team")) %>%
  left_join(df_qb_rush_att, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_rush_rate, by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  left_join(df_pass_rate %>% rename(n_pass_team = n_pass), by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_qb_all %>% 
      select(season, player_id, team, birth_date, years_exp, draft_number) %>% 
      mutate(draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260)),
    by = c("season", "player_id", "team")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25,
    team = 
      case_when(
        team == "SD" ~ "LAC",
        team == "OAK" ~ "LV",
        .default = team
      )
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id, season) %>% 
  mutate(
    rush_share = sum(n_rush, na.rm = T) / mean(sum(n_rush_team, na.rm = T), na.rm = T),
    mean_cpoe = mean(mean_cpoe, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  drop_na(team) %>% 
  arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  select(-prior_cpoe) %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      c(games_missed, rush_share, n_pass, sum_epa, mean_cpoe, adot, gl_att_share, sum_fpts, fpts_game),
      ~ case_when(
        row_number() == 2 ~ lag(replace_na(., 0)),
        row_number() == 3 ~ 0.65 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.35 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))),
        row_number() > 3 ~ 0.6 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.3 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))) + 0.1 * lag(lag(lag(replace_na(., 0)))),
        .default = NA
      ),
      .names = "prior_{col}"
    )
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    # prior_ays = prior_mean_air_yards_share,
    prior_cpoe = prior_mean_cpoe,
    prior_fpts = prior_sum_fpts,
    prior_qb_epa = prior_sum_epa
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

df_fan_qb_fin_all =
  df_fan_qb_fin_pre %>% 
  left_join(
    df_roster_qb_all %>% 
      left_join(df_fan_qb_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      left_join(
        df_fan_qb_fin_pre %>% 
          select(season, player_id, prior_rush_share),
        by = c("player_id", "season")
      ) %>% 
      # left_join(
      #   df_rush_rate %>% 
      #     select(season, team, prior_n_rush_team),
      #   by = c("team", "season")
      # ) %>% 
      mutate(
        top_20_other = sum(prior_ind_top_20, na.rm = T) - prior_ind_top_20,
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T) - prior_fpts,
        # expect_rush_other = sum(prior_rush_share * prior_n_rush_team, na.rm = T) - prior_rush_share * prior_n_rush_team
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(player_id, season, prior_fpts_other, prior_rank),
    by = c("player_id", "season")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(df_games_missed_qb_all, by = c("player_id", "season"))# %>% 
  # filter(prior_rank <= 100 | (prior_rank > 100 & prior_games_missed > 8 & sum_fpts >= 100) | (is.na(prior_rank)))
```

### Train models

```{r wr team prior}
# load("mod_df_as_of_2023.Rdata")
# load("coach_df_as_of_2025.Rdata")

df_off_epa = readRDS(str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_off_epa.rds"))
df_gl_eff = readRDS(str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_gl_eff.rds"))
df_def_epa_sos = readRDS(str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_def_epa_sos.rds"))

df_fpts_qb_train =
  df_fan_qb_fin_all %>% 
  filter(prior_rank <= 30 | (is.na(prior_rank)) | prior_fpts >= 150) %>% 
  # left_join(fin_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  # left_join(coach_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  # left_join(mod_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_off_epa, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_gl_eff, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_def_epa_sos, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(df_ol_cont_team, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  mutate(
    expect_rush = prior_rush_share * prior_n_rush_team,
    expect_gl_opp = prior_gl_att_share * prior_gl_trips
  ) %>% 
  select(player_id, sum_fpts, prior_qb_epa, prior_n_pass, prior_n_rush, prior_fpts, prior_cpoe, prior_adot, prior_off_pass_epa, player_age, draft_number, prior_fpts_other, qb_new_team, games_missed_rate, expect_gl_opp, expect_rush, ol_cont_grade_pass) %>% 
  select(-c(prior_n_pass, prior_n_rush, prior_cpoe, expect_gl_opp, player_age, prior_off_pass_epa)) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  arrange(player_id) %>% 
  select(-player_id) %>% 
  relocate(sum_fpts, .after = last_col())

saveRDS(df_fpts_qb_train, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fpts_qb_train.rds"))

view(df_fpts_qb_train)

cor(df_fpts_qb_train)

ctrl = 
  trainControl(
    method = "repeatedcv", 
    number = 5, 
    repeats = 10,
    savePredictions = "final"
  )

                data = df_fpts_qb_train, 
                #subset = season,
                method = "glm", 
                trControl = ctrl)
mod_glm_qb

# ENET
set.seed(37564)
mod_enet_qb = train(sum_fpts ~ .,
                 na.action = na.exclude, 
                 data = df_fpts_qb_train, 
                 method = "glmnet", 
                 tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), 
                                        lambda = exp(seq(-1, 2, length = 10))),
                 trControl = ctrl)
ggplot(mod_enet_qb, highlight = T) + 
  ggtitle("Lasso") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
mod_enet_qb$bestTune
min(mod_enet_qb$results$RMSE)

# KNN
set.seed(37564)
mod_knn_qb = train(sum_fpts ~ .,
                na.action = na.exclude, 
                data = df_fpts_qb_train, 
                method = "knn", 
                preProcess = c("center","scale"),
                tuneGrid = data.frame(k = seq(6, 30, by = 2)), 
                trControl = ctrl)
ggplot(mod_knn_qb, highlight = T) + 
  ggtitle("KNN") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
mod_knn_qb$bestTune
min(mod_knn_qb$results$RMSE)

# MARS
set.seed(37564)
mod_mars_qb = train(sum_fpts ~ .,
                 na.action = na.exclude, 
                 data = df_fpts_qb_train, 
                 method = "earth", 
                 tuneGrid = expand.grid(degree = 1:3, nprune = 3:12), 
                 trControl = ctrl)
ggplot(mod_mars_qb, highlight = T) + 
  ggtitle("MARS") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
mod_mars_qb$bestTune
min(mod_mars_qb$results$RMSE)

# Boost
set.seed(37564)
mod_boost_qb = train(sum_fpts ~ .,
                  na.action = na.exclude, 
                  data = df_fpts_qb_train, 
                  method = "gbm", 
                  tuneGrid = expand.grid(n.trees = c(1000, 5000, 9000),
                                         interaction.depth = c(2:3),
                                         shrinkage = c(0.0003, 0.0007, 0.0009),
                                         n.minobsinnode = 1), 
                  trControl = ctrl,
                  verbose = F)
ggplot(mod_boost_qb, highlight = T) + 
  ggtitle("Boost") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
mod_boost_qb$bestTune
min(mod_boost_qb$results$RMSE)

# SVM
set.seed(37564)
mod_svm_qb = train(sum_fpts ~ .,
                na.action = na.exclude, 
                data = df_fpts_qb_train,
                preProcess = c("scale", "center"),
                method = "svmRadialSigma",
                tuneGrid = expand.grid(C = exp(seq(-2, 0, len = 5)),
                                       sigma = exp(seq(-5,-3, len = 5))),
                trControl = ctrl)
ggplot(mod_svm_qb, highlight = T) + 
  ggtitle("SVM Radial") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
mod_svm_qb$bestTune
min(mod_svm_qb$results$RMSE)

set.seed(37564)
vip(
  mod_boost_qb,

)

summary(res)

df_oof_pred_qb = 
  mod_glm_qb$pred %>% 
  tibble() %>% 
  select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
  mutate(model = "glm") %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_enet_qb$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "enet")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_knn_qb$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "knn")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_mars_qb$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "mars")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_boost_qb$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "boost")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    mod_svm_qb$pred %>% 
      tibble() %>% 
      select(rowIndex, pred, obs) %>% 
      mutate(model = "svm")
  ) %>%
  group_by(model, rowIndex) %>%
  summarise(
    actual = first(obs),
    pred_oof = mean(pred)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    residual = actual - pred_oof,
    abs_residual = abs(residual),
    squared_residual = residual^2,
    # mod_var = log(squared_residual + 1),
    mod_var = abs_residual
  )

# Calibration:
df_resid_qb_train %>%
  cbind(
    df_fpts_qb_train %>%
      select(sum_fpts)
  ) %>%
  tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    mod_pred_fpts = predict(mod_svm_qb, newdata = df_fpts_qb_train),
    mod_pred_resid = predict(mod_knn_qb_resid, newdata = df_resid_qb_train),
    # mod_pred_var = exp(mod_pred_resid) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # mod_pred_sd = sqrt(mod_pred_var),
    residual = sum_fpts - mod_pred_fpts,
    mod_pred_sd = mod_pred_resid * sqrt(pi / 2),
    # mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(mod_pred_sd_quant) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sd = mean(mod_pred_sd),
    resid_sd = sd(residual)
  )

# coverage:
df_resid_qb_train %>%
  cbind(
    df_fpts_qb_train %>%
      select(sum_fpts)
  ) %>%
  tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    mod_pred_fpts = predict(mod_svm_qb, newdata = df_fpts_qb_train),
    mod_pred_resid = predict(mod_knn_qb_resid, newdata = df_resid_qb_train),
    # mod_pred_var = exp(mod_pred_resid) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # mod_pred_sd = sqrt(mod_pred_var),
    residual = sum_fpts - mod_pred_fpts,
    mod_pred_sd = mod_pred_resid * sqrt(pi / 2),
    # mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    mod_pred_sd_quant = ntile(mod_pred_sd, 5),
    cov_1sd =
      case_when(
        abs(residual) <= mod_pred_sd ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      ),
    cov_2sd =
      case_when(
        abs(residual) <= 2 * mod_pred_sd ~ 1,
        .default = 0
      )
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cov_1sd = mean(cov_1sd),
    cov_2sd = mean(cov_2sd)
  )
```

### Make model for rookies

```{r wr rookie}
fpts_qb_rookie_train_df =
  roster_qb_all %>% 
  filter(rookie_year == season) %>% 
  select(season, player_id, full_name, team, birth_date, draft_number) %>% 
  mutate(
    draft_number = replace_na(as.integer(draft_number), 260),
    player_age = as.double(as.Date(str_c(as.character(season), "-09-01")) - as.Date(birth_date)) / 365.25,
    team = 
      case_when(
        team == "SD" ~ "LAC",
        team == "OAK" ~ "LV",
        .default = team
      )
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(team) %>% 
  left_join(qb_epa_teams_df, by = c("season", "team")) %>% 
  left_join(
    fan_qb_all %>% 
      select(season, position, player_id, player_display_name, fpts) %>% 
      group_by(season, player_id, player_display_name, position) %>% 
      mutate(
        sum_fpts = 
          case_when(
            season < 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T) * 17 / 16,
            season >= 2021 ~ sum(fpts, na.rm = T),
            .default = NA
          )
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(season, player_id, sum_fpts) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = c("season", "player_id")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    roster_qb_all %>% 
      left_join(fan_qb_season_finish, by = c("player_id", "season")) %>% 
      select(player_id, season, team, full_name, fpts_total, season_rank) %>% 
      mutate(
        ind_top_20 = ifelse(season_rank <= 20, 1, 0)
      ) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, season) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_ind_top_20 = lag(ind_top_20),
        prior_fpts = lag(fpts_total),
        prior_rank = lag(season_rank)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(season, team) %>% 
      arrange(season, team) %>% 
      filter(season != 2016) %>% 
      mutate(
        prior_fpts_other = sum(prior_fpts, na.rm = T)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(season, team, prior_fpts_other) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = c("season", "team")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(fin_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  left_join(coach_df, by = c("team", "season")) %>% 
  group_by(season) %>%
  arrange(season, draft_number) %>% 
  slice_min(draft_number, n = 15) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(player_id, sum_fpts, prior_n_pass, prior_off_pass_epa, prior_fpts_other, player_age, draft_number, coach_exp_off) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  arrange(player_id) %>%
  select(-player_id)

view(fpts_qb_rookie_train_df)

mod_boost_qb_rook = train(sum_fpts ~ .,
                  na.action = na.exclude, 
                  data = fpts_qb_rookie_train_df, 
                  method = "gbm", 
                  tuneGrid = expand.grid(n.trees = c(3000, 5000, 7000),
                                         interaction.depth = 1,
                                         shrinkage = c(0.0003, 0.0005, 0.0007), 
                                         n.minobsinnode = 1), 
                  trControl = ctrl,
```

```{r pred test}
  ungroup() %>%

      arrange(player_id, season) %>%

        across(

          ~ case_when(
            row_number() == 1 ~ replace_na(., 0),

            row_number() == 3 ~ 0.6 * . + 0.3 * lag(replace_na(., 0)) + 0.1 * lag(lag(replace_na(., 0))),
            .default = NA

          .names = "prior_{col}"

      filter(season == 2025) %>% 
      select(player_id, player_display_name, prior_cpoe, prior_adot, prior_fpts, prior_qb_epa, prior_rush_share, prior_gl_att_share),

set.seed(37564)
df_fpts_qb_sim =
  df_fpts_qb_test %>% 
  mutate(
    pred_fpts_svm = predict(mod_svm_qb, newdata = df_fpts_qb_test),
    pred_resid_knn = predict(mod_knn_qb_resid, newdata = df_fpts_qb_test)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  arrange(-pred_fpts_svm) %>% 
  rowid_to_column("qb_rank_svm") %>% 
  select(qb_rank_svm, team, player_id, player_display_name, pred_fpts_svm, pred_resid_knn) %>% 
  mutate(
    # pred_var_knn = exp(pred_resid_knn) * smearing_factor - 1,
    # pred_sd_knn = sqrt(pred_var_knn),
    pred_sd_knn = pred_resid_knn * sqrt(pi / 2),
    # pred_sd_knn = sqrt(exp(pred_resid_knn) - 1)
    fpts_sim = 
      map2(
        .x = pred_fpts_svm,
        .y = pred_sd_knn,
        ~ rnorm(10000, mean = .x, sd = .y)
      )
  ) %>% 
  separate_longer_delim(fpts_sim, delim = ",") %>% 
  mutate(fpts_sim = as.double(str_remove(fpts_sim, "^c\\("))) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_sim_ind = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(player_sim_ind) %>% 
  arrange(player_sim_ind, -fpts_sim) %>% 
  mutate(
    fpts_sim_rank = row_number()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

saveRDS(df_fpts_qb_sim, str_c("data/fantasy_data/", "df_fpts_qb_sim.rds"))

df_qb_project_fin =
  df_fpts_qb_sim %>% 
  mutate(
    top_1 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank == 1, 1, 0),
    top_5 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 5, 1, 0),
    top_12 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 12, 1, 0),
    top_24 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 24, 1, 0),
    # top_36 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank <= 36, 1, 0),
    below_24 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank > 24, 1, 0),
    below_36 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank > 36, 1, 0),
    # below_50 = ifelse(fpts_sim_rank > 50, 1, 0),
    pred_fpts = round(pred_fpts_svm, 1)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id, team, qb_rank_svm, player_display_name, pred_fpts) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      c(starts_with("top_"), starts_with("below_")),
      ~ sum(.) / 10000,
      .names = "prop_{col}"
    ),
    pred_rank_med = median(fpts_sim_rank),
    pred_rank_mean = mean(fpts_sim_rank),
    pred_rank_90p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.1),
    pred_rank_80p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.2),
    pred_rank_20p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.8),
    pred_rank_10p = quantile(fpts_sim_rank, 0.9)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
    df_fpts_qb_sim %>% 
      group_by(player_id, team, player_display_name) %>% 
      arrange(player_id, team, player_display_name, fpts_sim) %>% 
      mutate(
        fpts_sim_quant = ntile(fpts_sim, n = 20),
        fpts_sim_quant_rank = row_number()
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      filter(fpts_sim_quant_rank %in% c(1000, 2000, 5000, 8000, 9000)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = fpts_sim_quant_rank,
        names_prefix = "quant_",
        values_from = fpts_sim
      ) %>% 
      rename(
        pred_fpts_med = quant_5000,
        pred_fpts_90p = quant_9000,
        pred_fpts_80p = quant_8000,
        pred_fpts_20p = quant_2000,
        pred_fpts_10p = quant_1000
      ) %>% 
      mutate(across(starts_with("pred_"), ~ round(ifelse(. < 0, 0, .), 1))) %>% 
      group_by(player_id) %>% 
      fill(starts_with("pred_"), .direction = "downup") %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(player_id, pred_fpts_med, starts_with("pred_fpts_") & ends_with("p")) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = "player_id"
  ) %>% 
  # select(-player_id) %>% 
  relocate(pred_fpts_med, starts_with("pred_fpts_") & ends_with("p"), .after = pred_fpts)

df_qb_project_fin_adp =
  df_qb_project_fin %>%
  left_join(
    df_adp,
    by = c("team", "player_display_name")
  ) %>% 
  # filter(is.na(adp))
  mutate(
    adp = as.integer(str_extract(pos_rank_adp, "\\d+")),
    rank_edge = adp - qb_rank_svm
  )

market_curve_qb = 
  df_qb_project_fin_adp %>% 
  drop_na(rank_edge) %>% 
  gam(
    pred_fpts ~ s(adp),
    data = .,
    method = "REML"
  )

df_qb_project_market = 
  df_qb_project_fin_adp %>%
  mutate(
    market_proj =
      predict(
        market_curve_qb,
        newdata = .
      ),
    market_edge = pred_fpts - market_proj,
    exp_finish_edge = adp - pred_rank_mean
  )

# view(df_qb_project_market)

df_adp_beat_qb = 
  df_fpts_qb_sim %>% 
  left_join(
    df_qb_project_fin_adp %>% 
      select(team, player_display_name, adp),
    by = c("team", "player_display_name")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    prop_adp_beat = mean(fpts_sim_rank < adp)
  )

df_qb_project_market_fin = 
  df_qb_project_market %>% 
  left_join(df_adp_beat_qb, by = "player_id")
```
